```

Build type: RelWithDebInfo

```

## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/c5641b2bfb01024572caae110fc22956d6e7555b) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

name: v0.8.175
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.175

Released on 2026-10-19.

Long films now play smoothly deep into the timeline, because the preview only does work for what is on screen. Cloud downloads resume after a dropped connection, and check, inspect and renders get going faster.

## Fixes

- **Core:** The preview keeps playing in time when its tab is hidden ([b168d0b41](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b168d0b4138cb578c07f21e12441c8302a217308), [#5872](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5872)).
- **CLI:** A cloud render download that loses its connection picks up where it stopped ([cea0bad79](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cea0bad7931122bd93680006978c0d9007daa3d4), [#5873](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5873)).

## Performance

- **Core:** Long films keep their frame rate deep into the timeline: playback and jumps do only the work for what is on screen ([959dd3e58](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/959dd3e584cc22ab9004926735ab9c3effc6d0cc), [#5754](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5754)).
- **CLI:** Check and inspect finish faster: they skip paint waits and screenshots nothing reads ([843494578](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8434945784b5378358a1c661aa080e1894533578), [#5868](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5868)).
- **Producer:** Renders embed a project's local fonts as they are, so setup is faster ([2b57809d7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2b57809d79176b34ce60f4206361e99fac618ccf), [#5865](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5865)).

## Internal

- Stop the fallow audit hook from piling up base snapshots ([aa63a8c70](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/aa63a8c70d8549d55533efdc7ed6d6559331b38c), [#5882](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5882)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.174...v0.8.175

name: v0.8.174
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.174

Released on 2026-10-19.

Deleting a time range from a timeline clip now removes only that range, not the whole clip. Cloud renders download faster, and Lambda renders assemble in seconds and scale to your account's limits.

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Timeline delete --start/--end removes only that range ([d2b8ea76443](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d2b8ea764431d739d5dd3ffed1df74470fa01fae), [#5867](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5867)).
- **Core:** Color grading applies to canvas compositions ([5658f700650](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5658f700650bb10c000229da9374df02b2f6b5ee), [#5860](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5860)).
- **Core:** Format generated artifacts without spawning bun from PATH ([d369159305c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d369159305c9471213a5e291b40ac3707a9f64a1), [#5859](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5859)).
- **CLI:** A page-load timeout names the script or stylesheet the page was waiting on ([adb7a6c994b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/adb7a6c994bf1d825a77b0aa9a2bd59418f8f97f), [#5727](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5727)).
- **CLI:** Capture keeps other screenshots when Chrome refuses one ([a9190303565](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a91903035658ddb0a6c3eda27b188eb58116135c), [#5739](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5739)).
- **Engine:** Exports carry full colour tags with every encoder, SDR and HDR ([ea742c50188](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ea742c501880cdcce141d8c10ea711a0e3ff7208), [#5742](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5742)).
- **Lint:** Back-to-back audio clips no longer count as overlapping after float rounding ([d1123299f8a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d1123299f8ade96e40f882d990d80de71ccaaefd), [#5837](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5837)).
- **CLI:** Preview inside a host app's agent run no longer outlives the run ([bf24fda8dab](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bf24fda8dab026fddfdb11922b8b0508f469d62d), [#5852](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5852)).
- **CLI:** Init writes the project into a folder with a non-ASCII name on Windows ([d58d3edd39b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d58d3edd39b05e7b4a3c7e90a78637471cd34c30), [#5833](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5833)).
- **CLI:** A render no FFmpeg encoder can finish stops before capture, not after it ([9fd5e4ae2df](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9fd5e4ae2df6dbee3cb15e045435dc7dc077b340), [#5831](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5831)).

## Performance

- **AWS Lambda:** Size distributed renders from account concurrency limits ([2a14cbc924a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2a14cbc924ab6bd08b1e5ee97eadb5da3374acff), [#5813](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5813)).
- **Cloud:** Assemble chunk output with a single faststart index ([70fbe32f8d9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/70fbe32f8d9ac9f214ad6f10b5be7301a64f4e85), [#5812](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5812)).
- **CLI:** Cloud render downloads the finished video over parallel connections ([cddb34feacf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cddb34feacf50f9637bf84893b5bd36a140385c9), [#5864](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5864)).

## Docs & Examples

- **CLI:** Say capture needs direct internet and ignores HTTPS_PROXY ([26d7dbca360](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/26d7dbca360b25b3ab48a0ee372fbbbc965de5cd), [#5752](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5752)).
- **Skills:** Make reference guides directly discoverable ([388011b2147](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/388011b2147bcfec910e09b9a865c80638f271f9), [#5858](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5858)).

## Internal

- **Engine:** Process tracker tests spawn node, not shell tools, so Windows runs stop timing out ([b98a1ac6e03](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b98a1ac6e031ee491fee456deb31c012f553c783), [#5832](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5832)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.173...v0.8.174

name: v0.8.173
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.173

Released on 2026-10-18.

Studio's install button now walks you through download, install and open in one card, and never dead-ends. Camera clips shot at 29.97 fps export smoothly at 30 fps, and check waits for slow CDN scripts the way render does.

## Features

- **Studio:** The desktop-app button says Install the desktop app and never dead-ends ([5975dd7579b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5975dd7579bfaaeff3db2e1b94549a0bfe296ece), [#5854](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5854)).

## Fixes

- **Engine:** A 29.97 fps camera clip exports smoothly at 30 fps ([b46ebedeae9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b46ebedeae959d3060ca4ece244ea6861d0f2352), [#5849](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5849)).
- **CLI:** Check and snapshot wait for a slow CDN script as long as render does ([18fc3901c79](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/18fc3901c79e05409ffc8521be7c903a1873533d), [#5847](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5847)).
- **CLI:** Agents can apply a color correction from media-treatment's capabilities ([e31838159d9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e31838159d90484818d68b985cc2f11971e82797), [#5850](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5850)).

## Internal

- **Lint:** Shader lint tests pass on macOS, where the temp folder is a symlink ([a971c2bb257](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a971c2bb257cf3f11feddab36c2b888b0e08a1cc), [#5851](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5851)).

## Full changelog

name: v0.8.172
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.172

Released on 2026-10-18.

Check and snapshot keep their report when another app has the project open, and capture works inside an agent sandbox. Audio finds the same files as preview, and later scenes no longer leak grain early.

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Check and snapshot keep their record while another app has the history open ([01adadb9181](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/01adadb91814a8fdca102c0a008ffac663c43dcd), [#5845](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5845)).
- **CLI:** Audio and timeline find media the way preview and render load it ([ab2e939558b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ab2e939558ba073ab725530d98f47a791ea6942d), [#5846](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5846)).
- **Core:** A scene paints no SVG filter grain before its start or after its end ([bb55640f5c6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bb55640f5c6869055d1a41d83809cfef63230030), [#5828](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5828)).
- **CLI:** Capture works inside an agent's macOS sandbox ([dc0e80e73af](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dc0e80e73af185cc892ea90d5a9f1412a055e9a1), [#5840](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5840)).

## Full changelog

name: v0.8.0
body:
# GPUI Kit v0.8.0 GPUI Kit 0.8.0 adds an installable JavaScript Shell runtime, Linux WebView support, and a public rendering boundary for external editors. It also adds lighter syntax highlighting with syntect, native-style scroll bounce, richer completion highlighting, and improvements to text selection, tables, focus and accessibility. ## Runtime and platforms - **Shell runtime**: run and scaffold JavaScript applications with `gpui-shell`; package them with `bundle`, and use `dev` for reloading during development. ([#3464](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3464), [#3487](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3487)) - **WebView**: use `gpui-webview` on macOS, Windows and Linux X11/XWayland. GPUI Fast enables overlays above native pages on macOS and Linux; bounds and clipping updates preserve the page viewport. ([#3395](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3395), [#3499](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3499), [#3591](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3591)) This release updates the optional GPUI Fast backend to **0.1.10**. The default backend remains pinned to **gpui-pre 0.3.9**, the latest published snapshot. The WebAssembly example uses wasm-bindgen **0.2.127** to match the updated backend dependency graph. ## Editor and text input - **External editors**: `gpui_kit::base::text::editor_host` lets an editor render a `BlockNode` tree through TextView and collect keyed leaf geometry while retaining its own document model, selection, commands and undo. ([#3580](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3580)) - **Syntax highlighting**: enable the `syntect` feature for a lighter highlighter with bat’s syntax collection; tree-sitter takes precedence when both are enabled. ([#3512](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3512)) - **Completion highlighting**: configure `Lsp::with_completion_highlighter` or `set_completion_highlighter` with `highlight_prefix`, `highlight_contains`, `highlight_characters`, or a host callback returning byte ranges. ([#3496](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3496)) - **Wrapping**: `display_map()` and `prewrap(...)` are available on InputState and TextareaState as well as EditorState. `Editor::size` supports the shared control sizes. ([#3483](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3483), [#3495](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3495), [#3564](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3564), [#3480](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3480)) - **Software keyboards**: configure `input_action`, `autocorrect` and `autocapitalize`; masked fields are identified as passwords, and clear/mask controls have accessible names. ([#3557](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3557), [#3555](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3555), [#3554](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3554), [#3562](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3562)) - Fixed caret clipping in one-row viewports, caret visibility during reflow and height changes, vertical scroll clamping, scrollbar reach in auto-growing textareas, and caret crispness on click. ([#3583](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3583), [#3477](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3477), [#3527](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3527), [#3515](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3515)) - Custom Find queries and case changes start near the viewport; an unchanged query retains its active occurrence. Android’s Back button keeps entered text when `clean_on_escape` is enabled. ([#3584](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3584), [#3556](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3556)) ## Markdown and text rendering - **Selection format**: `SelectionFormat::SourceAcrossStyles` copies plain text within a single style and Markdown source across styles. ([#3517](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3517)) - Copy uses the current gesture before repaint, including virtualized rich content. Unmounting a selection endpoint retires the old selection, so retaining and remounting a TextView cannot revive it. ([#3589](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3589), [#3588](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3588)) - HTML `
` creates a line break, and `
` / `
` preserve their text and whitespace through HTML minification. ([#3569](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3569), [#3570](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3570), [#3581](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3581))

## Scrolling and motion

- **Scroll bounce**: precise scrolling uses a shared boundary-bounce engine, enabled by default on macOS, iOS and Android. Desktop motion follows NSScrollView; ordinary line-wheel input does not bounce. Nested areas retain their own gestures. ([#3500](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3500), [#3484](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3484))
- **Horizontal strips**: `ScrollableMask::vertical_wheel` maps a plain mouse wheel to horizontal scrolling and chains to the parent at the edge. ([#3518](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3518))
- Cubic-bezier easing preserves anticipation and overshoot, and transitions and presence retain duration precision. ([#3432](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3432), [#3590](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3590))

## Components

- **DataTable**: fit a column by double-clicking its resize handle or calling `fit_col`, with widths supplied by `TableDelegate::fit_column`; inspect the result with `col_width`. Configure `fixed_cols_border`, `select_on_modifier_click` and `focus_ring`. ([#3489](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3489), [#3482](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3482), [#3523](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3523), [#3565](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3565))
- **DataTable**: Home/End select the first/last row in row mode; row selection preserves event propagation, and default column resizing is capped at 1200px while preserving explicitly assigned initial widths. ([#3471](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3471), [#3469](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3469), [#3472](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3472))
- **Resizable**: use the standalone `resize_handle` for application-owned handles and `ResizablePanel::fixed` to preserve a panel’s size when its container changes. ([#3302](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3302), [#3478](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3478))
- **Dock**: subscribe to `DockToggleEvent` to distinguish user-driven dock toggles. ([#3546](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3546))
- **MessageScroller**: read the current reading position through `MessageScrollerState::logical_scroll_top`. ([#3485](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3485))
- **Select**: keyboard confirmation and reconciliation of changed items preserve the intended selection. ([#3446](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3446))
- **Focus and accessibility**: focus traps preserve containment and accessibility; disabled controls report their disabled state; sliders can be named with `accessibility_label`; settings fields inherit their setting’s title. ([#3443](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3443), [#3531](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3531), [#3494](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3494), [#3524](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3524), [#3582](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3582))
- **Tooltip**: switching between triggers is direction-independent; a pressed trigger remains dismissed until the pointer leaves, and removing a trigger dismisses its tooltip. ([#3501](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3501), [#3492](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3492), [#3528](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3528))
- **Popover**: keyboard activation inside content remains available. ([#3586](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3586))
- **TabBar**: overflow-menu actions call the tab’s own handler, the sliding indicator appears after the first frame, and `TabVariant::Folder` adds a folder presentation. ([#3568](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3568), [#3574](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3574), [#3415](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3415))
- **Tree**: selection and toggling happen on click rather than mouse-down. ([#3567](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3567))

## Shell APIs

- **Extensible catalog**: `gpui_shell::components::registry()` returns the unfrozen component catalog for host additions. Registered state objects support `release()` so applications can promptly dispose of retained resources. ([#3542](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3542), [#3544](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3544))
- **Lists and transcripts**: script lists support `with_follow_mode("tail")` and `on_visible_range_change`; item-count changes preserve the reader’s position. MessageScrollerState exposes append/prepend/splice, measurement and scrolling operations. ([#3548](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3548), [#3549](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3549), [#3547](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3547), [#3541](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3541))
- **Script components**: the catalog includes WebView/WebViewState, and Base TextareaState exposes `set_submit_on_enter` for message composers. ([#3532](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3532), [#3550](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3550))
- **Runtime compatibility**: scripts gain gradient backgrounds and custom shadows, more browser/Node-compatible runtime APIs, and corrected filesystem link handling. Script errors report their cause, and launching a window on Wayland no longer crashes during activation. ([#3534](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3534), [#3505](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3505), [#3510](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3510), [#3561](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3561), [#3509](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3509), [#3508](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3508))

## Breaking Changes

### Support Linux on X11 and rename the crate to gpui-webview ([#3395](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3395))

The crate is renamed from `gpui-wry` to `gpui-webview`.

```diff
 [dependencies]
-gpui-wry = "0.7.1"
+gpui-webview = "0.7.1"
```

```diff
-use gpui_wry::WebView;
+use gpui_webview::WebView;
```

On Linux, applications using the WebView must start on X11:

```diff
-gpui_kit::application().run(|cx| { /* ... */ });
+#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
+let app = gpui_kit::platform::linux(WindowingModes::X11);
+#[cfg(not(target_os = "linux"))]
+let app = gpui_kit::application();
+app.run(|cx| { /* ... */ });
```

### Support gpui-pre and make `gpui-fast` optional again ([#3591](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3591))

Applications that relied on `gpui-webview` switching them to GPUI Fast must now select GPUI Fast on `gpui-kit` and enable the WebView feature with it, to keep overlays above the page on macOS and Linux:

```diff
 [dependencies]
-gpui-kit = "0.7"
-gpui-webview = "0.7"
+gpui-kit = { version = "0.7", features = ["gpui-fast"] }
+gpui-webview = { version = "0.7", features = ["gpui-fast"] }
```

Without both they build on gpui-pre; with only one of them, `gpui-webview` fails to compile and names the missing feature.

### Add SelectionFormat::SourceAcrossStyles ([#3517](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3517))

`SelectionFormat` is not `#[non_exhaustive]`, so code that matches it exhaustively needs an arm for the new variant.

```diff
 match format {
     SelectionFormat::Plain => ...,
     SelectionFormat::Source => ...,
+    SelectionFormat::SourceAcrossStyles => ...,
 }
```

### Let an application build its own resize handle ([#3302](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3302))

`ResizeHandle::on_drag` was `#[doc(hidden)]`; its constructor now takes `&T` instead of `Rc`:

```diff
- .on_drag(DragPanel, |drag, _, _, cx| cx.new(|_| drag.deref().clone()))
+ .on_drag(DragPanel, |drag, _, _, cx| cx.new(|_| drag.clone()))
```

### Bounce scrollable content like NSScrollView, by default on macOS ([#3500](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3500))

No existing signature changes. Every existing call still compiles. Four defaults change behavior, compared with `main`:

**1. `ScrollBounce` is enabled by default on macOS.** On `main` it was enabled only on iOS and Android. A `ScrollBounce` created without `.enabled(..)` now bounces on macOS too. To keep it still:

```diff
- ScrollBounce::new(id, &handle, child)
+ ScrollBounce::new(id, &handle, child).enabled(false)
```

**2. `ScrollBounce` owns vertical wheel scrolling by default.** On `main`, the child scrolled itself and the wrapper only stretched the deltas the child left unused. Now the wrapper scrolls the handle itself, through the shared engine. Code that relied on the child-owned mode, such as touch emulation or synthesized drags, must ask for it:

```diff
- ScrollBounce::new(id, &handle, child).enabled(true)
+ ScrollBounce::new(id, &handle, child).enabled(true).scroll_wheel(false)
```

**3. `ScrollBounceMotion::default()` changes on macOS, Windows and Linux.** The defaults are now tuned to match NSScrollView, replacing the UIScrollView tuning:
- `tracking` goes from 0.55 to 0.075.
- `response` goes from 524 ms to ≈503 ms.
- The stretch is capped at 36 px.

iOS and Android are unchanged. To keep the previous feel:

```diff
- ScrollBounce::new(id, &handle, child)
+ ScrollBounce::new(id, &handle, child).motion(
+     ScrollBounceMotion::default()
+         .with_tracking(0.55)
+         .with_response(Duration::from_millis(524)),
+ )
```

**4. Scrollable components scroll differently.**
- **They bounce on macOS.** Scrollable (`overflow_y_scrollbar()`), List, DataTable, Tree, Select, Command, Textarea, Editor, Sidebar, Diff, MessageScroller, the settings page and scrollable TextView now bounce on precise scrolling. On `main` none of them did. Each one that has a builder can turn it off:

  ```diff
  - List::new(&state)
  + List::new(&state).scroll_bounce(false)
  ```

- **Nested areas no longer scroll together, on every platform.** The innermost area under the pointer takes the whole gesture, including at its ends. On `main`:
  - Nested GPUI scroll divs scrolled together.
  - MessageScroller handed the wheel to an ancestor scroller once it reached an end.

  Neither happens now. Sidebar, Diff, MessageScroller, the settings page and TextView have no `scroll_bounce` builder; they always follow the platform default.

Everything else listed under Public API is new in this PR, and so additive.

### Keep a scroll over text that can scroll, even at its end ([#3484](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3484))

Scrolling over a textarea or editor whose text can scroll no longer reaches the page around it once the text is at its end: the rest of that swipe, its momentum, and later wheel flicks over the text stay in the input. Text that fits, and vertical scrolling over a single-line input, still scroll the page. No setting restores the old behavior; to scroll the page, move the pointer off the input.

### Add `Folder` variant ([#3415](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3415))

`TabVariant` is not `#[non_exhaustive]`, so exhaustive matches need the new arm:

```diff
 match variant {
     ...
+    TabVariant::Folder => ...,
 }
```

### Keep cubic-bezier anticipation and overshoot in Easing ([#3432](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3432))

- Code that relied on `Easing::sample` staying within `[0, 1]` for an out-of-range cubic-bezier curve now sees overshoot:

```diff
- let alpha = easing.sample(delta);
+ let alpha = easing.sample(delta).clamp(0., 1.);
```

### Select the first or last row on Home and End in row mode ([#3471](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3471))

In row mode, Home and End select the first or last row instead of the first or last column. No setting restores the old behavior: Left and Right still move to a column, and a host that wants Home and End to pick a column can select one with `set_selected_col`.

### Don't stop event propagation in `set_selected_row` ([#3469](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3469))

`TableState::set_selected_row` no longer stops event propagation. Custom handlers that require it must call `cx.stop_propagation()` explicitly.

### Skip the notify in `set_line_number` when nothing changes ([#3475](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3475))

In a code editor, `set_line_number` no longer notifies when the line numbers are already as asked. A caller that relied on that call to re-render the editor notifies it itself:

```diff
  state.set_line_number(true, window, cx);
+ cx.notify();
```

### Notify from set_searchable only when it changes ([#3576](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3576))

`ListState::set_searchable` no longer notifies when the list is already searchable or not as asked. A caller that relied on that call to re-render the list notifies it itself:

```diff
  list.set_searchable(true, cx);
+ cx.notify();
```

### Add `bundle` to package an application, and a `dev` command ([#3487](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3487))

`--dev` no longer implies `--watch` or a debug log. `dev` is the command that reloads.

```diff
- gpui-shell run -d app --dev
+ gpui-shell dev -d app          # reload + debug log
+ gpui-shell dev -d app --dev    # … and the relaxed sandbox, as before
```

`InvocationKind` gains a variant, so an exhaustive `match` over it needs a `Bundle` arm.

```diff
  match gpui_shell::host::parse_invocation(arguments)? {
      InvocationKind::Run => …,
+     InvocationKind::Bundle => …,
      …
  }
```

### Fix the runtime gaps found by the gpui-shell benchmark apps ([#3505](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3505))

`gpui-shell run -d ` with a manifest now stores data under the manifest `id`, the same place the installed copy uses, instead of `-`. Data written by earlier development runs stays in the old directory.

`process.env` was absent before; scripts that feature-detected it with `typeof process.env === "undefined"` now see an object.

`Capabilities`' read and write roots for a local run now include the manifest's roots rather than only the app and data directories, so `gpui-shell list` reports a wider grant for manifests that ask for one.

### Extend UI testing with semantic queries and Linux rendering ([#3402](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3402))

Existing pointer helpers now retain held modifiers. Callers that deliberately require an unmodified click while modifiers are held can request it explicitly; ordinary calls and signatures remain valid.

```diff
- window.click("save", cx); // previously reset held modifiers implicitly
+ window.click_with_options("save", ClickOptions::new(), cx); // explicitly unmodified, then restores held state
```

Nested context-menu callers keep the same construction. The corrected interaction is:

```diff
- window.right_click("inner-trigger", cx); // both inner and ancestor menus opened
+ window.right_click("inner-trigger", cx); // only the innermost menu opens
```

### Add find_all and configurable clicks to the UI test harness ([#3384](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3384))

`TestWindowExt` gains two required methods: `find_all` and `click_with_options`.
Downstream implementations must implement both. `click_with_modifiers` has a default
implementation through `click_with_options`. Call sites continue to import only
`TestWindowExt` for all window queries and interactions.

```diff
 impl TestWindowExt for MyTestWindow {
     // Existing methods remain.
+    fn find_all(&self, id: impl Into) -> Vec {
+        self.window.find_all(id)
+    }
+    fn click_with_options(&mut self, id: impl Into, options: ClickOptions, cx: &mut App) {
+        self.window.click_with_options(id, options, cx);
+    }
 }
```

Thank you to everyone who contributed code, documentation, testing, and feedback!

## What's Changed
* kit: Add optional gpui-fast backend by @huacnlee in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3375
* tooltip: Make show delay and grace period configurable with `TooltipDefaults` by @madcodelife in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3376
* docs: Explain recovering focus when the focused element stops rendering by @AncientPixel in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3386
* diff: Add readonly patch viewer by @huacnlee in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3378
* kit: Use one Windows manifest with GPUI Fast by @huacnlee in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3380
* test: Add find_all and configurable clicks to the UI test harness by @AncientPixel in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3384
* test: Make Progress and TitleBar findable in UI tests by @AncientPixel in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3383
* input: Preserve selection, focus ring and context menu actions by @lurenjia534 in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3382
* diff: Add a Git history example and complete review APIs by @huacnlee in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3388
* webview: Compose native views with the GPUI Fast backend by @ihavecoke in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3389
* text_view: Ignore gestures that stay inside one block plugin by @ylinwind in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3390
* text_view: Round the first and last table rows to the frame radius by @ihavecoke in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3309
* webview: Support Linux on X11 and rename the crate to gpui-webview by @huacnlee in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3395
* webview: Require GPUI Fast for gpui-webview by @huacnlee in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3398
* resizable: Let an application build its own resize handle by @ihavecoke in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3302
* menu: Open a context menu with a long press on touch by @Bombatomica64 in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3393
* text_view: Keep narrow table columns on one line by @madcodelife in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3399
* kit: Extend UI testing with semantic queries and Linux rendering by @huacnlee in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3402
* settings: Keep focus rings inside the list viewport by @lurenjia534 in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3394
* scrollable_mask: Keep rounded scroll-table corners clean at any scroll offset by @ihavecoke in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3400
* dialog: Add margin_top to AlertDialog by @xxww0098 in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3404
* input: Add InputState::add_selection for programmatic multi-cursor by @sola-ryu in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3403
* text_selection: Stop writing selection state on every frame by @huacnlee in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3407
* table: Make the sort icon a labelled button by @AncientPixel in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3396
* table: Report visible row ranges of one row or none by @AncientPixel in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3397
* dialog: Support configurable entrance animations by @xxww0098 in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3405
* docs: Explain the open_dialog builder and footer contracts by @xxww0098 in https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3406

name: v18.12.2
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Changed

- The failed-tool-call correction sent to DeepSeek models now also covers chat-template tool-call tokens written out as text, not only malformed DSML ([#16216](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16216) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Fixed

- Fixed Ollama chat history estimates counting stripped native thinking and missing foreign thinking replayed as text, which skewed compaction after model switches ([#16164](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16164))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added `nativeJudgmentImageBounds()`: the image bounds a native judge enforces, its wire's transport limits tightened by the catalog's model bounds
- Added Box judgment questions (`BoxQuestion`/`BoxAnswer`, TypeSafe Jev 1.14+ direct or through OpenRouter): each names the request image it searches by `image` index, and comes back as that image's edges as 0–1 fractions; text, OpenAI Decisions, and Workers AI judges reject them

### Fixed

- Fixed Muse Code usage going stale whenever its 5-hour window sits idle: the idle window now reports as unused, and weekly usage carries over from the last active window until its reset ([#16193](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16193) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Fixed DeepSeek tool calls never running when the model writes them as chat-template tokens with `_` in place of `▁`, a missing `｜`, or no per-call close (e.g. `<｜tool_calls_begin｜>…<｜tool_calls_end｜>`): they now run as tool calls, and any that still cannot be parsed are removed from history and reported to the model as a failed call ([#16216](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16216) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

## @oh-my-pi/browser-relay

### Fixed

- Fixed a relay tab close failing when Chrome refuses it for a moment (a tab being dragged); the extension retries it ([#16119](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16119) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed tabs created for a relay request whose connection dropped mid-create staying open, and answers to such requests going to a later connection ([#16119](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16119))
- Fixed the relay resolving an old tab id to a different tab after a browser restart; the extension now reports each browser run ([#16119](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16119))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Changed

- Seeded TypeSafe `jev-1.14.0` and OpenRouter `typesafe/jev-1.14`, and made them the `judge` role defaults and TypeSafe's default model; TypeSafe discovery keeps seeded ids its alias-only `/v1/models` listing omits

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added `computer.backgroundFallback` (`takeover` by default, or `refuse`): when a `computer` window input call has no background route, the tool reruns that one call in takeover, hands focus back to your app and says so in its result; `refuse` fails the call instead and also refuses the agent's own foreground requests (`takeover: true`, `raise()`, an activating `apps.open`, desktop input, and on macOS menus and `AXOpen`) ([#15191](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15191) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added DeepSeek as a web search engine (`web/deepseek`), using DeepSeek's new Search API with your existing `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` or stored `deepseek` credential
- Added `el.selectText(text, { prefix?, suffix?, select? })` to the macOS `computer` tool: it selects text (or places a caret) in a background app's text field without taking focus, moving the pointer or sending keys, so typing into that field replaces it ([#15175](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15175) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added `{ takeover: true }` to computer-use `win.move`, so a hover that a window refuses in the background can be retried in the foreground ([#15173](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15173) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added a `menu` option to the `computer` tool's `win.click`, `el.click`, `el.press` and `el.perform`, so on macOS the call that opens a menu also chooses its item, e.g. `menu: ["Add to", "Fonts"]` ([#15185](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15185) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added `el.type(text)` and `el.press(chord)` to the `computer` tool, which send text and keys to that element instead of wherever its window's focus is; on macOS and Windows nothing is sent when the element cannot be addressed without taking your focus ([#15563](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15563) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added: pressing Escape during takeover input now stops computer use for the rest of the turn, and that session's later `computer` calls are refused, unsent, until your next message ([#15564](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15564) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added the `computer` tool's `UserIntervened` error on macOS: input into an app you have used since the agent last read its window fails without sending, and the agent is told to read the window again and keep your edits ([#15562](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15562) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added `tui.completeScrollback`: rows a growing HUD or dialog pushes off screen go straight to scrollback instead of missing from it until it shrinks ([#15692](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15692) by [@Ilm-Alan](https://github.com/Ilm-Alan))

### Changed

- The `computer` tool and its errors no longer tell the model to retry with `takeover: true`, and its instructions tell it never to call `raise()` or `apps.open(…, { activate: true })` to make input work ([#15191](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15191) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Computer-use window input with `takeover` omitted now stays in the background after `computer.control.acquire`, so an acquired grant no longer activates the target app or moves the user's pointer; pass `takeover: true` for foreground input ([#15173](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15173) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Pressing Escape in your own app no longer stops the `computer` tool's background window input unless task control is held; Escape in omp still interrupts it, and physical Escape still stops takeover input ([#15176](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15176) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added Box questions to `ChainJudge`: they go only to Jev judges that answer them, and the box edges measure the image you passed even when it was padded to fit Jev's size bounds
- A relay `browser.open` without `app.target` now opens its own background tab instead of adopting the visible one (after reinstalling the relay extension; older ones select it), and `browser.close` closes it; `app.target` still borrows an existing tab ([#16119](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16119) by [@nnnnoel](https://github.com/nnnnoel) and [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Computer-use `win.menu.items` now needs `exec` approval and is rejected in `read_only` runs, since on macOS it makes the window key in its own application before reading its menus ([#15184](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15184) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- The `computer` tool no longer takes over your screen for macOS drags and holds on sliders, scroll bars, splitters and steppers, modified clicks, right-clicks and scrolls; they run in the background ([#15185](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15185) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- The default `judge` role now uses TypeSafe Jev 1.14 (`typesafe/jev-1.14.0`, then `openrouter/typesafe/jev-1.14`): `jev-latest` is TypeSafe's stable alias and answered as `jev-1.13.0`
- Idle compaction on a 1-hour prompt cache (Anthropic long retention) now runs just before the cache entry expires, about 54 minutes after the last request, so the summary still reads the cached context; `compaction.idleTimeoutSeconds` still applies with a 5-minute cache or an unknown lifetime ([#16198](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16198), [#16204](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16204) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Tool-call intents now say what the agent wants from the call's output and what it already knows (e.g. "Find where the retry delay is computed and whether it honours Retry-After; the client is in http.py") instead of a short label like "Reading config file"

### Fixed

- Fixed repeated status commands such as `/goal show` showing nothing after the first few times in a native terminal when the text had not changed
- Fixed browser relay tabs that a browser already had open when its extension connected staying invisible to omp until they changed; opening such a tab by `app.target` could fail with "Selected tab did not become available before omp could attach"
- Fixed Ollama Cloud sessions compacting too early on stripped thinking or too late after switching from another model ([#16164](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16164))
- Fixed Google sign-in rejecting the `/login perplexity` SSO browser window with "This browser or app may not be secure"; the sign-in browser no longer runs in automation mode ([#16141](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16141))
- Fixed `task.softRequestBudget` never stopping Cursor subagents ([#16182](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16182) by [@joseotaviorf](https://github.com/joseotaviorf))
- Fixed image judgments (`judge()`/`judge_batch()` with images) leaving TypeSafe Jev for the local `tiny` model whenever an image fell outside Jev's 280–1568 px bounds, which most screenshots do: images are now resized into the bounds, and strips padded, before Jev sees them
- Fixed a Codex turn stopping on "Request failed … unsupported_native_inflight_message" when you sent a message while the response was writing text; the session now keeps the partial reply and continues with your message
- Fixed the `bash` tool dropping variables, functions, and shell options between calls whenever auto-background was on (the default): a call that starts in the foreground now runs in the session's persistent shell, a failing command under `set -e` or an `exit` no longer resets that shell, and a call that overlaps a still-running one says it ran in a temporary shell ([#16153](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16153) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed the macOS `computer` tool's `StaleRef` for an element the app rebuilt in place, such as an Automator rule popup after its neighbour changed, leaving the agent to re-read the window: it now names the one element of the window with the fields the ref was read with, for the agent to check before acting on it ([#15574](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15574) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed an eval cell's `timeout` aborting an awaited `tool.task(...)` or `tool.wait(...)` and losing its subagents' results: time spent waiting on them no longer counts against the cell, as with `agent()` handles, while a turn cancel still stops them ([#16154](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16154) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed the Up arrow crashing omp with `text.replace is not a function` when `history.db` was damaged; recall skips unreadable rows, and a damaged store is moved aside to `history.db.corrupt-*` with every readable prompt, session title, and recap copied into its replacement ([#15751](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15751) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain))
- Fixed browser `tab.screenshot()` raising Chrome over the app you were typing in and switching its visible tab; background tabs and windows behind other apps are now captured in place, including ones idle long enough that Chrome stopped drawing them, as is a relay or `app.cdp_url` tab the user switched away from ([#15174](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15174) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed tabs omp opens through a relay shared by two browsers landing in whichever browser reconnected last; they open in the browser of the tab omp used last, else the one showing the first selected tab ([#16119](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16119) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a relay `browser.close` after a browser restart closing a tab the user had opened since, when Chrome reused the old tab's id; a tab omp opens while its browser's relay extension reconnects now waits for it instead of opening in another browser, and one Chrome finishes creating after the extension's connection dropped is closed ([#16119](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16119))
- Fixed `computer.run` and browser `tab.run` silently dropping `args` that were not an array (such as `{ args: { path } }`) or were given with a code string, so the function ran without them after its first steps had already acted; both now throw before the run starts, while omitted or `null` `args` still pass none ([#16149](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16149) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `computer` helpers or browser tab calls started together (such as `Promise.all` over `computer.window`) failing with a bare "Computer worker is busy" or "Tab … is busy"; the error now says to await each call before starting the next, or group the steps in one `computer.run` or `tab.run` ([#16149](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16149) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Commands in `bash` can hand `skill://`, `local://`, and other file-backed URLs to external programs again (`python skill://example-skill/tool.py "query"`), and can run them from a `cd`'d writable URL directory such as `local://`; a URL the provider rejects, such as an unknown skill, now fails the command with the provider's error ([#14838](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14838) by [@koyzdev](https://github.com/koyzdev))
- Fixed `computer.apps.open` returning before the app had a window, or never giving a hidden running app one; it now returns the app's frontmost window as `window`, waiting up to 3 s on macOS ([#15184](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15184) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a key you were typing on macOS arriving twice or more when omp exited after computer use ([#15562](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15562) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `omp --restore` and `/retry` reporting nothing to retry for a turn cut off by a process exit in a session that had used `eval`; the interrupted turn now continues ([#16195](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16195))
- Fixed session loading on Windows treating a session path with a regular-file component as a missing session (an empty session) instead of rejecting it with `ENOTDIR` like POSIX does ([#16145](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16145) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023))
- Fixed models from extension providers listed in `enabledModels` or `--models` missing from `/model`, the Ctrl+P cycle and the startup model scope notice until the background catalog refresh finished ([#16096](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16096) by [@skipper019](https://github.com/skipper019))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- Added a `refuseMenu` option to `click`, `drag` and `holdMouse`: a macOS background left click on a menu button or popup button, or a drag or hold starting on one, throws `BackgroundUnavailable` before anything is sent ([#15191](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15191) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added a `returnFocus` option for window input with `takeover`: on macOS the takeover hands focus back to your app even if you clicked meanwhile, and only a third app you switched to keeps focus ([#15191](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15191) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added `DesktopSession.axSelectText` (macOS) to select text in an accessibility element's value by UTF-16 range, refusing missing or ambiguous matches and returning the selection read back ([#15175](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15175) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added a `menu` item path to `click` options and `axPerform`: a macOS click or action that opens a menu chooses that item, submenus included, and leaves no menu open ([#15185](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15185) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added `DesktopSession.axType` and `axKeyChord`, which type into or press keys in one accessibility element; on macOS a field that does not report keyboard focus gets nothing and the error names what has focus; on Windows background input goes straight to the element's own control window and refuses a windowless element ([#15563](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15563) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added `DesktopSession.escapeStops` and `desktopEscapeStops(key)`, counting takeover input you stopped with physical Escape on macOS, Windows and X11, apart from host cancels ([#15564](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15564) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added `UserIntervened` on macOS: keys and clicks stop at your first key or click in the app they go to, and input to an app you used since it was last read waits up to 5 s for you to pause, then fails without sending (needs Input Monitoring) ([#15562](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15562) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Changed

- Reduced Mermaid XY-chart rendering overhead while preserving chart colors and layout ([#16214](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16214) by [@kyle-elliott](https://github.com/kyle-elliott)).
- Reading recent commit subjects in a long Git history now reads only the commits requested instead of walking the whole history ([#16210](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16210) by [@kyle-elliott](https://github.com/kyle-elliott)).
- Improved AST search and edit performance in directories containing many unsupported files ([#16213](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16213) by [@kyle-elliott](https://github.com/kyle-elliott)).
- Faster numbered source formatting for hashline reads ([#16211](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16211) by [@kyle-elliott](https://github.com/kyle-elliott)).
- Improved word-diff performance for inline change highlighting ([#16212](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16212) by [@kyle-elliott](https://github.com/kyle-elliott)).
- Window input calls, element `axClick`, `axType` and `axKeyChord` included, resolve to a `DesktopFocusReturn` (`handedBack`, `previousPid`, `frontPid`) when a macOS takeover ran, and to `null` otherwise ([#15191](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15191) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- `BackgroundUnavailable` and partial-delivery errors no longer tell the caller to retry with `takeover:true`; they say whether any input was sent ([#15191](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15191) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Reduced allocation overhead for uncached, result-limited file searches in large directory trees ([#16115](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16115) by [@kyle-elliott](https://github.com/kyle-elliott)).
- Desktop window input with `takeover` omitted is now background on every platform even while task control is held; only `takeover: true` selects foreground delivery ([#15173](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15173) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Computer use's physical Escape stop now watches the keyboard only during takeover input (`takeover: true`, held control, desktop-level input, raises); without held control, an Escape the user presses in their own app no longer cancels background window input, which the host interrupt still stops ([#15176](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15176) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- macOS background keys, typing, left clicks and menu commands now refuse with `BackgroundUnavailable` when aimed at a non-key window of the app you are using, or once you have come to the target app, instead of moving your typing there; keys sent while another window of the target app becomes key stop with `InputFailed` ([#15184](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15184) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- macOS `win.menu.items` now makes the window key within its app before reading, so it takes the input lock and throws `InputBusy` while another operation holds it ([#15184](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15184) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- macOS background drags and holds on sliders, scroll bars, splitters and steppers, modified clicks, right-clicks, Electron scrolls and Tk 8.5 clicks now run without bringing the app forward; drags that could pick up files or text still throw `BackgroundUnavailable` ([#15185](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15185) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- Fixed macOS `UserIntervened` missing your input during element writes (`axSelectText`, `setValue`, native-field typing, AX actions and popups), a reused Open/Save panel process id counting another app's input, and an event tap started during exit staying live ([#15562](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15562))
- Fixed macOS remote-screen `press`/`holdKeys` landing in a Screen Sharing window you brought forward during the layout read, iPhone Mirroring dropping a press right after a release, and a modifier two characters need being pressed twice ([#15193](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15193))
- Fixed the macOS focus guard missing switches while a click hit-test stalled and missing an app the action brought forward 200–500 ms after its last send; background actions now keep guarding for that window before returning ([#15195](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15195))
- Fixed macOS key rerouting sending your keys to the app you had left after you switched to a third app, letting a menu that still held the keyboard from an earlier action take your keys, and dropping a theft when key focus could not be read ([#16140](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16140))
- Fixed macOS keys and mouse buttons staying down when omp is killed or its native input code panics mid-gesture; a key or button you are physically holding is left for you to release ([#15192](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15192) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS and X11 background input throwing `BackgroundUnavailable` ("nothing was sent") after part of the call was already sent; it now throws `InputFailed`, and on macOS a call stopped because you came to the target app throws `UserIntervened` ([#15191](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15191) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS takeover `InputFailed` naming only the target window when another held focus; it now names the app's focused window, such as an alert or sheet, or the app that stayed in front ([#15191](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15191) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a macOS `takeover: true` click or key that opened a document or closed a sheet or panel leaving its app in front for good; focus now returns to your app unless you clicked or pressed a shortcut during the takeover ([#15191](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15191) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the in-process `cksum --check` panicking on a tagged checksum line that starts with `(` (for example `(file)= <hash>`) instead of reporting it as an invalid checksum line ([#16142](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16142) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023))
- Fixed `grep --path-separator` leaving `\` separators untouched in printed paths on Windows, so displayed paths no longer mix `\` with the configured separator ([#16143](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16143) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023))
- Fixed macOS computer use reporting a working physical Escape stop (`globalEscape: true`) when Input Monitoring was turned off and the stop could not see keys; `inputPermission` now reports event-posting access, and permission errors name the terminal or IDE to grant ([#15157](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15157) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a persistent `Shell` session discarding its variables, functions, and options when a command ran `exit` or stopped under `set -e`; those now end only the command, and only a failed run resets the session ([#16153](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16153) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Fixed a macOS element-ref `StaleRef` giving no lead when the app destroyed the element and put an identical one in its place: the error now names the one element of the window with the fields the ref was read with, registered as a new ref, and sends nothing to it ([#15574](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15574) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS takeover input sending the user back to their previous app when they clicked in the takeover target as the input ended, and keeping the target in front for good when they merely kept typing while takeover held it: a click, a shortcut (any key with Command or Control, such as Command-Tab or Control-Up, a function key or a Globe shortcut), or a switch to another app now leaves the front app to the user, and macOS refuses the hand-back if one came after the takeover's own input; plain typing alone no longer does, once Input Monitoring lets omp tell it apart ([#15176](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15176) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS background input taking keyboard focus from your app, which then dropped pastes and shortcuts until clicked again, and the focus guard sending your app back to the front just after you picked the target yourself ([#15184](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15184) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS background input doing nothing or landing in the wrong place for Chrome pages, apps with several windows, Finder, sheets, popovers, inline editors such as Finder's rename field, and system Open/Save panels; keys for a window behind its own focused sheet now throw `InvalidTarget` naming the sheet ([#15184](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15184) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed TextEdit and Script Editor freezing after a background ⌘S, and background shortcuts reporting success when the app stopped answering; they now throw `InputFailed` saying the outcome is unknown ([#15184](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15184) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS `win.menu.items` and `win.menu.select` treating commands such as Font Book's File ▸ New Collection as disabled while the app was in the background or had not yet caught up with an edit ([#15184](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15184) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS `openApplication` leaving a hidden running app without a window and bringing Notes or Contacts to the front; it now shows the app behind yours and returns its first window ([#15184](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15184) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS background and takeover input refusing while your front app showed no window, as Finder does after a click on the desktop ([#15184](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15184) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a macOS background AX action that failed yet brought its app forward, such as `AXOpen` in Chrome's Open panel, leaving that app in front of yours ([#15184](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15184) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS background right-clicks, menu button presses and popup `setValue` leaving a menu open in the target app, which took your keyboard; the menu now closes, and a right-click or press that opened one throws `InputFailed` ([#15185](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15185) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a macOS `menu` path or background `press()` on a popup in an Open or Save panel, such as Automator's Where: popup, failing to find its menu ([#15185](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15185) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed your typing landing in the macOS app a background action targets when that app brings itself to the front while you type ([#15195](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15195) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS background input sending you back to your previous app after you opened the target app from Spotlight during the action ([#15195](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15195) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed an app that a macOS background action opens something in, such as TextEdit after a background ⌘O in Finder, staying in front of your app; it is sent back like the target ([#15195](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15195) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a key you typed on macOS reaching your app twice or more when a process holding a computer-use event tap exited; `closeDesktopEventTaps()` closes them first ([#15562](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15562) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

- Fixed your keystrokes landing in the app a macOS background action targets, or vanishing into a menu it opened, when it takes the keyboard mid-action; they now reach your app ([#16140](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16140) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

name: Reasonix CLI v2.45.0
body: CLI archives built from the Studio release [studio-v2.45.0](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases/tag/studio-v2.45.0).

name: Reasonix Studio v2.45.0
body:
本版新增定时任务、会话排序与跨项目移动、手机提醒、WSL 远程、Git 面板、反馈贡献榜、规则目录与按名称关闭工具，推理强度可在进行中的回合里切换，并修复内置浏览器页面缩放、终端卡顿、子代理识图等一批问题。

## 新增

- `reasonix schedule add|list|tick` 等命令，在终端确认后按时间只读地运行任务；需用系统计划任务调用 `schedule tick`。关联 #11406。
- Studio 打开且可见（窗口或托盘图标）时，会按计划自动运行已确认的定时任务；同一时刻只有一个内核执行。关联 #11406。
- 会话菜单里可以把会话上移或下移，也可以在会话行上按 Alt+上下键；顺序保存在内核里，重启后不变。关联 #11420。
- Linux 增加 `.AppImage` 下载（amd64 和 arm64），可直接运行；它不会自更新，新版本需重新下载。关联 #11653。
- 浏览器和工作台可以全屏查看，会话与输入框暂时收起，按 Esc 或再点一次回到分栏；有事等你决定时自动退出全屏。关联 #11721。
- 登录同一账号的手机可在有操作待批准、模型提问、一轮出错时收到提醒，通知只含类别和数量。电脑和手机两边默认都关，需分别开启。关联 #11878。
- MCP 服务器因授权范围不够拒绝调用时，模型会停下，你可在该服务器那行点“授权更多权限”，每次都会先问你。关联 #11959。
- 在“我的反馈”里可以撤回自己的反馈（命令行用 /feedback withdraw）；已登记的议题会被关闭，已有结论的反馈不能撤回。关联 #11995。
- 可选的等级提示（设置里“等级提升时通知我”，默认关）：反馈等级提高时在窗口顶部提示一次，终端 /feedback list 说一行。关联 #12025。
- 在“我的反馈”的对话里，你自己的回复旁会显示你的等级徽章，维护者的回复旁没有。关联 #12025。
- 关联账号的电脑上，“我的反馈”会列出其他已关联设备的反馈和回复；终端新增 /feedback link、unlink、links。关联 #12073。
- 设置 → 远程可以添加本机的 WSL 发行版：内核运行在发行版里，界面仍在 Windows；关闭 Studio 后内核随发行版停止，对话会保留。关联 #12225。
- 终端界面的 /mcp 面板里，返回 401 的服务器可按 a 登录，要求更多权限的服务器可按 u 授权，都会先问你。关联 #12357、#11959。
- ACP 会话支持 `additionalDirectories`，多文件夹工作区可让会话写入额外文件夹，仅限该会话，且经过与手动授权相同的检查。关联 #13114。
- ACP 支持 `$/cancel_request`、消息块 `messageId`、权限请求带工具名，并按客户端声明转交 MCP 的表单与外部页面。关联 #13114。
- 可选的追踪导出，在用户配置里开启并填写收集器地址后，每轮对话以 OpenTelemetry 追踪发给你自己的观测系统；默认关闭，只发结构和名称。关联 #13115。
- 反馈面板里的“贡献榜”，按版本有名次，自己选择加入并预览名字，随时退出；终端用 /feedback board。服务端开启后才显示。关联 #13142。
- 会话菜单里可以把会话移到另一个项目，只带走对话和标题、置顶、归档；权限设置、检查点、后台任务日志和排队消息不随移动，原件会被移除。关联 #13370。
- 设置里的 SearXNG 地址旁新增「测试连接」，说明连不上的原因；只测已保存的地址，不连云元数据等地址；搜索失败时模型也收到同一原因码。关联 #13541。
- 大文件优先引用本地路径，无路径时流式上传；默认 1 GiB 上传安全上限可由用户配置调整。关联 #13544 by @SivanCola。
- 实验性，未经真实端点验证：原生 Gemini 提供方（Interactions API），支持思考、工具调用与视频（含 Files API）。关联 #13615。
- 可在设置里打开“把视频地址交给模型厂商”（默认关闭）；只交你亲手写的 https 地址，厂商自己访问，智谱 GLM 与 Gemini（YouTube）支持。关联 #13616。
- 子代理的面板行、完整记录标题和嵌套卡片都会显示它实际跑在哪个模型和强度上，失败或中断的也有。见 #13640 fixed in #13812。
- 模型现在可以请你打开它需要的开关（比如派发到其他项目），你点一下确认才生效；安全边界类设置它永远改不了。关联 #13678。
- 在输入框输入 # 可选一段本工作区的历史会话，作为只读资料带进这条消息；搜索命中也能引用，长度上限可在设置里调。关联 #13687、#11942。
- 模型可用 task 的 task_id 给运行中的子代理补充指示，它在下一次调用工具时读到；设置里可调单条大小和每分钟上限。关联 #13693。
- mod 的安装预览写明完全信任与静态清单；mod 可在输入框上方画一条带，它的提问会写明来源。关联 #13694。
- 把鼠标移到你发的消息上，操作图标旁会显示这条消息的发送时间，长时间运行的任务可以据此核对起止时间。关联 #13697。
- 设置 → 扩展里，你自己和项目文件夹里的技能多了「卸载…」，确认框写明要删除的位置；内置技能和由包提供的技能不显示。关联 #13714 fixed in #13725。
- 终端里的 /mcp 面板现在可以添加和删除 MCP 服务器（按 n、d），添加前会完整显示将要运行的命令并要你确认。关联 #13754。
- 工作台里的 Git 面板：改动按文件夹树显示，可整个文件夹暂存、丢弃单个文件的改动，推送前先预览目的地，历史里的提交可展开看文件和差异，非仓库的项目文件夹会按仓库分组显示。关联 #13821。
- 终端里 /btw <问题> 在旁路问一个只读问题，答案只显示一次，不存入会话、不进入提示词。关联 #7950 fixed in #13757。
- `reasonix acp --permission-mode` 供把 Reasonix 当子代理嵌入的宿主使用：固定审批姿态，客户端只能降低不能抬高，旧存档的更高姿态被限制且文件不改。议题 #13839。
- 连接可以声明余额接口的返回格式；其他域名（如中转站）必须选择格式，否则显示未配置，也不发密钥。关联 #13736。
- 设置里可以让新对话默认进入计划模式（agent.default_mode，默认关闭）；已有对话保持自己的模式。关联 #7852 fixed in #13760。
- 状态栏显示当前按供应商哪个时段计费（高峰或平峰）和还有多久切换，只在模型用的是供应商自己的价格表时显示。关联 #8853。
- Studio「人设」页提供用户级前后缀及运行时上下文开关；内置指令保留，项目不能设置人设。保存后在新会话或下次会话重建时生效。关联 #13588 by @SivanCola。
- 连接编辑器里，每个模型价格下可填价格来源链接和核对日期（UTC）；只显示主机名，点击才打开，不会自动访问。议题 #13276。
- 支持规则目录（.reasonix/rules、.claude/rules 和用户目录下的 rules），可用 paths: 限定到某些文件；不影响缓存前缀。关联 #9886 fixed in #13766。
- 可以按名称关闭工具（[tools] disabled，设置里每个工具有开关），关闭后不再发给模型，调用会被拒绝；被其他功能依赖的保留并提示。关联 #8394 fixed in #13763。

## 变更

- 服务商支持逐请求设置思考强度时，切换强度不再重建会话，进行中的回合里也能切，下一次请求起生效。见 #11411。
- 会话等你回答时（含 Auto Guard 确认卡、沙盒越界提问）让出写入权；其间别的会话占了这些路径，会告知模型并记入回执，最长等待可设。见 #11531 fixed in #13842。
- task 工具新增 task_id 参数，升级后的第一轮对话，工具说明的缓存会冷一次，之后恢复。关联 #13693。
- 通过 ACP 连接时，失败的对话回合改为以 JSON-RPC 错误（-32603，data.code 为 turn_failed）结束，不再返回规范之外的 stopReason "error"。关联 #13703。
- 通过 ACP 连接时，模型缺少密钥或尚未配置提供方，新建会话返回协议规定的“需要认证”错误（-32000），客户端可据此引导运行 reasonix setup。关联 #13705。
- 通过 ACP 连接时，因“尚未验证”被暂停的回合以 end_turn 结束，响应带 paused 结果，文本末尾追加 [paused] 回执。关联 #13706。
- 通过 ACP 连接时，状态类扩展通知需要客户端在初始化时声明 statusUpdates 才会发送，会话记录路径改放在响应的 _meta 里。关联 #13721。
- 打开设置里的“派发”开关就是对派发的总同意：任务和回信不再出审批卡；新会话沿用发起会话的模型、预设、审批档位和计划模式，且不会更宽。见 #13526。
- 已装的全信任权限扩展现在也会被已安装的 MCP 工具咨询（只能收紧，不能放宽）。见 #13694。
- 常驻放行的会话间消息只会越过宿主自己设的暂停，不会越过你主动按下的暂停，它会留在队列里等你。关联 #13775。
- 本机与 SSH 项目统一展示；“打开项目”移至标题旁的加号，支持统一折叠与展开。提交 da051abb2。
- 会话采用中性选中背景；可选的悬停置顶、归档按钮默认关闭，菜单始终可用；修复环境切换、重复点击及焦点问题。PR #13638 by @SivanCola。
- 远端读取与未指定目录的打开共用主机默认目录，已有会话不会改变读取目标或绕过禁用检查。PR #13638 by @SivanCola。
- 未登记的 SSH 主机在连接前返回明确拒绝，远端写入接口的请求体限制为 64 KiB。PR #13638 by @SivanCola。

## 修复

- 代码编辑器及其查找栏的字号现在跟随外观里的界面字号，不再固定在 12px 和 11px。关联 #11577。
- 撤回反馈后，它对应的 GitHub 议题会被自动关闭（标记为不计划处理）。关联 #11995。
- 迁移数据根之后，窗口里仍记着旧位置的会话现在能按文件名在新的会话目录里打开，不再提示“没有这个会话”。关联 #13152。
- `[[keep]]` 标记的回合现在有自己的保留预算（窗口的 15%，新的优先），超出的旧回合并入摘要并提示；共享窗口的模型在回复空间用尽前就会压缩。见 #13320、#12773。
- 压缩时摘要请求被供应商以“输入超长”拒绝，现在会按更小的输入重试（70%、50%、35%），而不是放弃这次压缩。见 #13320。
- 有系统沙盒把 shell 限在项目文件夹里时，同一 git 仓库下两个项目里的会话不再因 bash 等无声明写入互相等待；没有沙盒（如 Windows）时仍整库互斥。见 #13335 fixed in #13851。
- 委派任务里点名了粘贴的截图（.reasonix/attachments 下的文件）时，子代理现在能收到图并切到识图模型；技能子代理也不再悄悄丢图。见 #13642 fixed in #13876。
- 刚进入窗格就打开分支菜单时，菜单会被自己的挂载收尾关掉，或一直停在加载中。关联 #13674。
- 模型调用跨项目派发被拒时，会说明是“允许模型把任务交给别的会话”开关没开，并指出设置位置，不再和“此会话无法打开别的项目”混为一谈。关联 #13677 fixed in #13679。
- 有新版本时，设置弹窗左侧列表里的「版本」一行也会出现和左下角设置图标一样的提示点，打开设置后能直接看到该点哪里。关联 #13682 fixed in #13685。
- Windows 上会话文件名含大写字母（如自定义模型名）时，顶部标题和标签总显示“新会话”。关联 #13684。
- 标题栏的搜索按钮在查找栏已打开时再点一次会关闭它，不再只是重新聚焦；快捷键和命令面板仍然是打开。关联 #13696 fixed in #13701。
- 你自己发的消息下面的操作图标（复制、改写、回退）和 AI 回复下面的一样大，不再偏小。关联 #13699 fixed in #13704。
- 侧栏搜索框有关键词时不再在失焦后收起，点搜索结果的第一下不会再因为列表上移而落空。关联 #13708。
- 技能目录顶层放了 SKILL.md 时，卸载它会把整个技能目录连同其他技能一起删掉；现在只删这一个文件。关联 #13714 fixed in #13725。
- 模型偏好里的“网页搜索”不再列出尚未添加的连接下的模型；选不了时的提示也改为“还没有添加”，不再误称“已被移出”。关联 #13806 fixed in #13813。
- HTTP 连接里输入 `!` 命令被拒后，命令会整段选中留在输入框，接着打字就是替换，下一条普通消息能直接发出。关联 #13810。
