<!-- lang:en -->

This release adds scheduled tasks, session moves, phone reminders, WSL remotes, a Git panel, a contribution board and rules directories, lets reasoning depth change mid-turn, and fixes browser scaling, terminal slowdown and sub-agent image reading.

## New

- `reasonix schedule add|list|tick` and friends: a read-only task runs when you confirm it in a terminal; call `tick` from your OS scheduler. Refs #11406.
- While Studio is open and visible (a window or tray icon), it runs the schedules you confirmed; only one kernel ticks at a time. Refs #11406.
- A conversation can be moved up or down from its menu or with Alt+Arrow on its row; the order is kept by the kernel and survives restarts. Refs #11420.
- Linux gets an `.AppImage` download for amd64 and arm64 that runs in place. It does not update itself: download the next release. Refs #11653.
- Full-screen browser and workbench with the conversation folded away; Esc or the button restores the split, and it exits by itself when something needs your decision. Refs #11721.
- phones on the same account can be reminded when an action awaits approval, the model asks, or a turn fails; only the kind and a count are sent. Off by default on both sides. Refs #11878.
- When an MCP server refuses a call for lack of access, the model stops and you can click "Grant more access" on its row; you are asked every time. Refs #11959.
- You can withdraw your own report from My feedback (or /feedback withdraw in the terminal); its issue is closed, and a report with an outcome can no longer be withdrawn. Refs #11995.
- An optional level-up notice (Settings "Tell me when my level goes up", off by default): one note at the top of the window, one line in /feedback list. Refs #12025.
- In a My feedback thread, your level badge now sits beside your own replies and never beside a maintainer's. Refs #12025.
- On a linked device, My feedback also lists reports and replies from your other linked devices; the terminal gains /feedback link, unlink, links. Refs #12073.
- Settings, Remote can add a WSL distribution on this PC. The kernel runs in it and stops with it when Studio closes; conversations are kept. Refs #12225.
- In the terminal /mcp panel, press a to sign in to a server that answered 401, or u to grant one the extra access it asked for; you are asked first. Refs #12357, #11959.
- ACP sessions accept `additionalDirectories`, so a multi-folder workspace can give a session extra write roots, for that session only and with the usual vetting. Refs #13114.
- ACP supports `$/cancel_request`, `messageId` on chunks and tool names on permission requests, and forwards MCP forms and pages when advertised. Refs #13114.
- Opt-in trace export: once your user config enables it and names a collector, each turn goes to your own observability stack as OpenTelemetry traces; off by default. Refs #13115.
- A contribution board in the feedback panel, ranked per release; you choose to join, preview the name and can leave. Terminal: /feedback board. Refs #13142.
- Move a conversation to another project from its menu; permissions, checkpoints, task logs and queued messages stay behind and are removed. Refs #13370.
- A Test connection button beside the SearXNG address says why an instance does not answer; it tests only the saved one, never a metadata address. Refs #13541.
- Large files use native references or streaming; the default 1 GiB upload safety ceiling is user-configurable. Refs #13544 by @SivanCola.
- (experimental, not run against the real endpoint) a native Gemini provider on the Interactions API with thinking, tools and video. Refs #13615.
- a Settings switch (off by default) to hand a public video address you wrote to the model vendor, which visits it itself; Zhipu GLM and Gemini (YouTube). Refs #13616.
- a sub-agent's panel row, full-record header and nested card now show the model and effort it actually ran on, failed or interrupted runs included. See #13640 fixed in #13812.
- The model can now ask you to turn on a switch it needs (such as dispatching to another project), applied only when you confirm; boundary settings it can never change. Refs #13678.
- Type # in the message box to reference a past conversation of this workspace as read-only material; search hits can be referenced too, with a size limit in Settings. Refs #13687, #11942.
- The model can give a running sub-agent more guidance with task's task_id, read at its next tool call; Settings sets the size and per-minute limits. Refs #13693.
- A mod's install preview states full trust and a static listing; a mod can draw a band above the prompt, and its questions say whose they are. Refs #13694.
- Hovering your own message now shows when it was sent next to its action icons, so a long-running task's start can be checked against it. Refs #13697.
- Settings > Extensions can remove a skill of your own or the project's, after a confirmation naming the place to be deleted; built-in and package skills do not offer it. Refs #13714 fixed in #13725.
- The terminal's /mcp panel can now add and remove MCP servers (n, d), showing the full command it would run and asking you to confirm first. Refs #13754.
- A Git panel in the workbench: a folder tree of changes to stage and discard, push with a preview, commit details, and a section per repository. Refs #13821.
- In the terminal, /btw <question> asks a read-only side question: the answer is shown once and is not saved to the session or sent into its prompt. Refs #7950 fixed in #13757.
- `reasonix acp --permission-mode`, for hosts embedding Reasonix as a subagent, fixes the approval posture: clients can lower it, never raise it; a higher saved posture is clamped. Issue #13839.
- A connection can declare the format its balance endpoint answers in; a relay must pick one or shows as not configured and is not sent the key. Refs #13736.
- Settings can start new conversations in plan mode (agent.default_mode, off by default); existing conversations keep their own mode. Refs #7852 fixed in #13760.
- The status bar shows which of the vendor's billing windows (peak or off-peak) the model is in and how long until it changes, only where the model is billed at the vendor's own rate. Refs #8853.
- Studio Persona settings add user-level prefix/suffix text and a runtime-context switch, preserving built-in guidance. Applies at the next session build. Refs #13588 by @SivanCola.
- A model's price in the connection editor can carry a source link and a check date (UTC); only the host is shown, the link opens when clicked and is never fetched. Issue #13276.
- Rules directories (.reasonix/rules, .claude/rules and the user's rules folder), optionally scoped to files with paths:; the cache-stable prefix is untouched. Refs #9886 fixed in #13766.
- Tools can be turned off by name ([tools] disabled, a switch per tool in Settings): they leave every request and a call is refused; tools another feature needs stay, with a note. Refs #8394 fixed in #13763.

## Changed

- when the provider takes reasoning depth per request, changing it no longer rebuilds the session and works mid-turn, taking effect on the next request. See #11411.
- a session waiting on you gives up its write claim, Auto Guard and sandbox-escape asks included; contention reaches the model and receipt, and the longest wait is a setting. See #11531 fixed in #13842.
- The task tool gains a task_id parameter, so the tool-description cache is cold once on the first turn after upgrading and then warm again. Refs #13693.
- Over ACP, a failed turn now ends with a JSON-RPC error (-32603, data.code turn_failed), not the non-standard stopReason "error". Refs #13703.
- Over ACP, opening a session with a keyless model or no provider now returns the protocol's "Authentication required" error (-32000) so clients can offer reasonix setup. Refs #13705.
- Over ACP, a turn paused as unverified now ends with end_turn, a paused outcome and a [paused] receipt at the end of the text. Refs #13706.
- Over ACP, the vendor status notifications are sent only to clients that declare statusUpdates at initialize, and the transcript path moves into the response _meta. Refs #13721.
- the Dispatch switch is your consent: tasks and replies come in with no card, and the opened session keeps the sender's model, preset, approval mode and planning, never wider. See #13526.
- existing full-trust permission extensions are now also consulted for installed MCP tools (they can only tighten). See #13694.
- A message let in by a standing release starts only over a pause the host set itself, never over one you pressed; it stays queued for you. Refs #13775.
- Local and SSH projects share one list. Open Project moves to the heading's plus button, alongside collapse/expand all. Commit da051abb2.
- Neutral session selection offers opt-in hover Pin and Archive, off by default; session menus remain available. Environment routing, repeated clicks, focus and stream budgets are fixed. PR #13638 by @SivanCola.
- Remote reads and unqualified opens share the host default. Existing panes cannot redirect a read or bypass a disabled host. PR #13638 by @SivanCola.
- Unknown SSH hosts are refused before connecting; remote mutation request bodies are limited to 64 KiB. PR #13638 by @SivanCola.

## Fixed

- The code editor and its search bar now follow the interface text size in Appearance instead of staying at 12px and 11px. Refs #11577.
- When a report is withdrawn, its mirror GitHub issue is now closed automatically as not planned. Refs #11995.
- After the data root is moved, a conversation the window remembers by its old location opens from the new session folder by file name. Refs #13152.
- [[keep]] turns now have their own budget (15% of the window, newest first); older ones fold with a notice. Shared-window models fold before the reply runs out of room. See #13320, #12773.
- when the provider refuses a compaction's summary request as too large, it is retried with a smaller input (70%, 50%, 35%) instead of giving up the fold. See #13320.
- with an OS sandbox confining the shell to its folder, sessions in two projects of one git repository no longer wait on each other for bash writes; without one they still do. See #13335 fixed in #13851.
- a delegated task naming a pasted screenshot (a file under .reasonix/attachments) now gives the sub-agent the image on the vision model; skill sub-agents no longer drop it. See #13642 fixed in #13876.
- Opening the branch menu just as a pane settles no longer shuts it or leaves it loading forever. Refs #13674.
- When cross-project dispatch is refused because the user's switch is off, the error now says so and names the setting, not a generic "cannot open sessions". Refs #13677 fixed in #13679.
- When a newer release is known, the Version row in the settings list now carries the same mark as the gear, so the update entry is easy to find. Refs #13682 fixed in #13685.
- on Windows the header and tab always read "New chat" when the transcript file name had upper-case letters (for example a custom model name). Refs #13684.
- Pressing the title bar search button while the find bar is open now closes it instead of only re-focusing; the shortcut and the palette still open it. Refs #13696 fixed in #13701.
- The action icons under your own messages (copy, edit, rewind) are now the same size as those under a reply instead of smaller. Refs #13699 fixed in #13704.
- The rail's search box stays open while it holds a query, so the first press on a result is no longer lost to the list moving up. Refs #13708.
- Removing a skill whose SKILL.md sits at the top of a skills folder deleted the whole folder with every other skill; it now deletes only that file. Refs #13714 fixed in #13725.
- the web-search model picker no longer lists models from unadded connections, and a refused pick now says "not added" rather than "removed". Refs #13806 fixed in #13813.
- Over an HTTP connection a refused `!` command now stays selected in the box, so what you type next replaces it and the next ordinary message sends. Refs #13810.
- A page the agent laid out wider than the pane (for example 1440 wide) showed only its left part in the built-in browser; it is now scaled to fit. Refs #13811 fixed in #13835.
- A built-in browser page given a viewport smaller than the panel is centred at its own size, and clicks on a page scaled to fit the panel land where they were aimed. Refs #13811 fixed in #13835.
- when a project or external folder is moved, renamed or deleted, tools now say the folder is gone instead of a bare system error, and the window prompts to choose it again. Refs #13833.
- OpenCode Go's documented endpoint (opencode.ai/inference/go/…) no longer fails with 400 for lack of the session header. Refs #13849 fixed in #13860.
- /effort on a custom provider with no declared reasoning levels now says so and points at supported_efforts instead of claiming the model does not support them. Refs #13857 fixed in #13863.
- Two model services on one host but different ports were merged into one and the new one never showed; the port is now part of the address, and exact duplicates are listed too. Refs #13858 fixed in #13865.
- the terminal UI slowed down as a command's output, an answer or its thinking grew, since each appended piece copied everything so far; appending now costs the same at any length. See #13872.
- clicks the agent sent the built-in browser were dropped yet reported done while Studio was minimized; the window is now raised unseen for input, then minimized again (Windows). See #13628.
- A message from another session that you approved on its card now starts even when the send queue is paused; what was queued before stays paused. Refs #13775.
- An @token in the text of a message from another session is no longer read as a local file reference, and an unreadable one no longer pauses the send queue. Refs #13775.
- In the terminal, /feedback said "not available in this session" until a /reload; it now works from the start. Refs #12073.
- The usage page's paid figure no longer includes a subscription-equivalent estimate; it is its own labelled line and sits beside each day. Issue #13276.
- With automatic download chosen, opening the Versions page now checks for a release at once and starts the download, instead of waiting for the next daily background check. Issue #13683 fixed in #13875.

body:
### Patch Changes

- 66e4771: Reject `--port=<n>` and `--api-key=<key>` with incompatible transports, matching the space-separated forms.
- 6a54ec3: `--port` rejects values that are not an integer from 0 to 65535, and the port-in-use retry stops at 65535 instead of crashing.

name: @upstash/context7-mcp@4.4.3
body:
### Patch Changes

- 1b00727: Update the MCP SDK to `@modelcontextprotocol/server` 2.3.1 and `@modelcontextprotocol/node` 2.1.1, which converts tool schemas lazily, so each per-request server costs less to build. On the 2026-07-28 protocol, `tools/list`, `prompts/list`, `resources/list`, `resources/templates/list` and `server/discover` now return `ttlMs: 3600000` and `cacheScope: "public"`, so clients can reuse them for an hour instead of listing on every request. `resolve-library-id` now sets `isError: true` when the library search fails; a search with no matches is still a normal result.

  On SIGTERM the HTTP server now finishes the requests on open connections before it closes the MCP handler, and answers them with `Connection: close`. Before, those requests got HTTP 499 or 500 from the closed handler, and the shutdown hit its 5 s limit and exited with code 1. The SDK's rejections of malformed client requests are now logged as one line without a stack trace.

# oh-my-codex 0.21.21

`0.21.21` is a patch release for Windows shim path correctness, stale-launcher warning improvements, team worker readiness enforcement, and dynamic version handling in tests (5 commits, 7 files, +174/−104; PRs #3833, #3835, #3837).

## Highlights

- **Windows shim path generation on POSIX (#3833):** Fix path generation for Windows shims on POSIX systems to use host paths instead of stray backslash-prefixed paths. Filesystem writes in setup/uninstall/codex-hooks no longer create unintended `\tmp\…` entries.
- **Team worker readiness deadline (#3835):** Enforce the configured readiness deadline on the final poll, preventing team worker readiness from reporting ready after the timeout expires.
- **Stale-launcher warning diagnostics (#3837):** Restore test coverage for stale-launcher warnings and split messaging by provenance reason (missing-launcher vs. incompatible provenance). Diagnostic output is more specific and test assertions are comprehensive.

## Compatibility

- Setup/uninstall operations on POSIX systems now generate correct host paths for Windows shim artifacts.
- Stale-launcher warning behavior is unchanged; test coverage is restored and messaging is more specific.

# oh-my-codex v0.21.19

`0.21.19` is a patch release for agent model configuration and third-party provider fixes with correctness improvements for profile-scoped model resolution and provider classification (19 commits, 16 files, +925/−41; PRs #3824, #3825, #3827, #3828, #3829, #3831, #3832).

## Highlights

- **Third-party provider model pins (#3824, fixing #3823):** stop baking `exactModel` pins for agents using third-party providers, allowing providers to rotate their default models while keeping agents resolvable. Reported by @hetingyi.
- **Runtime-inherited model detection (#3825, fixing #3822):** align `omx doctor` spark-lane model checks with runtime-inherited agent model behavior, eliminating false positives that `omx setup --force` could never clear. Reported by @hetingyi.
- **Profile-scoped model overrides (#3827):** honor profile-scoped agent model settings and override guidance in generated agent runtime config.
- **Effective profile model resolution (#3831):** resolve active profile models before built-in fallbacks, keep exact pins when built-in providers omit models, and avoid claiming fallback models for provider-only configs.
- **Provider classification normalization (#3832):** normalize provider IDs consistently to preserve case sensitivity while ensuring matching behavior across configuration generation, exact pins, and metadata.
- **Final readiness poll (#3829, #3832):** always perform final team readiness poll before the timeout deadline and prevent startup from blocking when timeout budget is exhausted.

## Compatibility

- Agent generation and setup now correctly handle third-party provider model changes without requiring reinstallation.
- Doctor diagnostics no longer report valid runtime-inherited configurations as stale.
- Profile-scoped model overrides are now applied to all agents, not just those with explicit pin overrides.
- Built-in provider model resolution now correctly reflects configured models across generation, pinning, and metadata.
- Team startup respects configured readiness timeout boundaries.

## Validation

- Pinned candidate `987f4b0d73f1f6c369ad24758c31197412dc3451` passed latest-per-name dev CI: 17 checks succeeded and 8 conditional checks were skipped, with no failures.
- Release branch CI passed with all required checks green after rerunning known flakes (macOS Ralplan preflight at 30m timeout).
- All Codex review findings resolved across release branch and dev merge.

> _"The net is vast and infinite." — Motoko Kusanagi, 《Ghost in the Shell》 (1995)_ ## ✨ What's New | Feature | Description | | --- | --- | | **Three levels of folders** (Gemini, AI Studio) | You can now create a subfolder inside a subfolder. _(closes #718)_ | | **ChatGPT Local Bridge works in the background** | The bridge opens its ChatGPT tab in the background and does everything there, so it no longer takes over your window. You can keep working in other tabs and apps. | | **Local Bridge and the Pro usage ring in every language** | Model and effort selection, sending, projects and the Pro ring now work whatever language ChatGPT is set to, not only Chinese. | ## 🐛 Bug Fixes | Fix | Description | | --- | --- | | **Folder guides** | The nesting lines now sit under each folder's arrow and no longer cut through chat icons at 125% display scaling. | | **Gemini hidden archived chats** | The sidebar keeps asking for older chats when Gemini drops the request, instead of getting stuck at the bottom. _(refs #1040)_ | | **ChatGPT Local Bridge** | Project lists, file lists and the latest reply are read from ChatGPT's own data, so a slow network no longer yields a partial list or an older reply. A reply ChatGPT failed to finish, or one held up by a usage limit, is reported as such instead of being returned as the answer. | | **ChatGPT Local Bridge** | The Voyager CLI can ask for the latest page data with `voyager update` (CLI 0.2.0 or later), instead of waiting for the next scheduled check. | | **Icons** | Voyager's icon is redrawn so it stays sharp at every size. | _All changes by @Nagi-ovo unless noted._ --- ## 中文版 > _「网络是广阔无垠的。」——草薙素子，《攻壳机动队》（1995）_ ## ✨ 新功能 | 功能 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | **三级文件夹**（Gemini、AI Studio） | 子文件夹里可以再建一层子文件夹了。（关联 #718） | | **ChatGPT 本地桥改在后台运行** | 本地桥会在后台打开 ChatGPT 标签页并在那里完成所有操作，不再抢你的窗口，你可以在别的标签页和应用里照常干活。 | | **本地桥和 Pro 用量环支持所有界面语言** | 选模型和思考强度、发送、项目操作和 Pro 用量环，不管 ChatGPT 设成什么语言都能用，不再只认中文界面。 | ## 🐛 修复 | 修复 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | **文件夹层级线** | 层级线对齐到每个文件夹的箭头下方，显示缩放为 125% 时也不再穿过对话图标。 | | **Gemini 隐藏已归档对话** | Gemini 丢掉加载请求时，侧栏会继续请求更早的对话，不会卡在底部。（关联 #1040） | | **ChatGPT 本地桥** | 项目列表、文件列表和最新回复改为读取 ChatGPT 自己的数据，网速慢时也不会只拿到一半的列表或旧回复。ChatGPT 没能写完的回复、被用量上限挡住的回复，会如实报错，不再当成答案返回。 | | **ChatGPT 本地桥** | Voyager CLI 可以用 `voyager update` 立即拉取最新的页面数据（需要 CLI 0.2.0 及以上），不用等下一次定时检查。 | | **图标** | Voyager 的图标重新绘制，在各种尺寸下都清晰。 | _除特别注明外，均由 @Nagi-ovo 提交。_ **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager/compare/v2.1.0...v2.1.1 ## 📥 Installation
     

Edge users: Voyager is still maintained on Edge Add-ons for users who need Edge on mobile or tablet. If review is delayed, Chrome Web Store and GitHub manual packages remain available.

Those files are repository source snapshots, not browser-ready extension packages.
🍎 Safari 安装与升级说明 (Safari installation & upgrade) > 🎉 从 v1.6.0 起，Voyager 的核心功能已正式覆盖 Safari。 > Starting with v1.6.0, Voyager's core experience is officially supported on Safari. - 📦 **安装 (Installation)**: 下载并打开 `voyager-v2.1.1.dmg`，按提示安装应用。 Download and open `voyager-v2.1.1.dmg`, then follow the prompts to install the app. - ⚠️ **旧版升级 (Legacy upgrade)**: 如果仍安装着 `Gemini Voyager.app`，请先完成一次 [Safari 迁移步骤](https://voyager.nagi.fun/guide/safari-migration)，避免两个 App 并存。 If `Gemini Voyager.app` is still installed, follow the one-time [Safari migration guide](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/safari-migration) first so the two apps do not conflict. - 🖼️ **图片能力 (Images)**: Image Refinement 水印去除、全尺寸图片下载与聊天导出中的图片提取均已支持。 Image Refinement watermark removal, full-size image downloads, and image extraction in conversation exports are supported. - ☁️ **原生云同步 (Native cloud sync)**: Google Drive 与 iCloud 同步均已接入 Safari 原生层。 Google Drive and iCloud sync are integrated through Safari's native layer. - 🔔 **系统通知 (Notifications)**: Gemini 回复完成后可发送 macOS 通知，并直达对应对话。 macOS can notify you when a Gemini response finishes and open the matching conversation. - 🔄 **自动更新 (Automatic updates)**: 完成这次迁移后，后续版本可通过 Sparkle 自动更新。 After this one-time migration, future versions can update automatically through Sparkle.

## ✨ What's New | Feature | Description | | --- | --- | | **ChatGPT Local Bridge** _(off by default)_ | Lets programs on your computer bridge to ChatGPT on the web, with primitives to open a chat, send a prompt with files, wait for and read the reply, and manage project files. Reference usage: [Voyager CLI](https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager-cli), for the terminal and coding agents. | | **ChatGPT Pro usage this week** _(off by default)_ | A small ring next to the model picker shows how much GPT-6 Pro you've used this week; hover it for the count. name: openclaw 2026.10.10-beta.2
body:
## 2026.10.10-beta.2

### Highlights

### Changes

### Fixes

- Workspace safety: reject a multi-file `apply_patch` before changing files when a later update target is missing or its context does not match, preserving the original workspace for the next attempt. Commit-time I/O failures can still leave partial effects. (#160409; related #117742 and #127496) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, and @yetval.
- Tool policy: run plugin `before_tool_call` hooks in standalone `openclaw agent exec` sessions so plugin tool guards take effect. (#159333; fixes #158824) Thanks @joseairosa and @obviyus.
- Buzz: reconnect when a relay closes during NIP-42 authentication without terminating the Gateway or interrupting other channels and sessions. (#170591; fixes #147269) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @jarvis-modern-mail, and @RomneyDa.
- macOS downloads: save dashboard and conversation attachments through the native Save dialog while keeping the current page open. (#173654) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
- OpenRouter onboarding: accept valid API keys with the default `openrouter/auto` model instead of rejecting setup with a route mismatch. (#173292; related #162798) Thanks @chandraveshchaudhari and @obviyus.
- macOS setup: let fresh native profiles start the Gateway and complete automatic setup, including when supervised startup needs a retry. (#173246)
- Gateway startup: follow a replacement model-runtime refresh instead of exiting when initial preparation is superseded. (#173366; related #173357) Thanks @Jackten and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway logging: keep serving and shut down normally when a deleted temporary-directory backing path makes daily log rollover fail. (#160433; fixes #130807) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @WadeOwenWatts, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
- Gateway stability: stop session diff capture from opening live SQLite and hard-linked files, preventing SIGBUS crash loops when the shared-memory file is truncated. (#174017)
- Native app updates: let Doctor finish agent database upgrades on native-first profiles instead of reporting success while the Gateway refuses to start on an older schema. (#174297)
- Cron: plan history maintenance from run identities and load full payloads only for rows it updates, so large cron histories no longer exhaust the SQLite worker's memory and take channels down. (#174530; fixes #174078) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, and @asikorskiy.
- Windows Claude CLI: stop every turn with a stored Anthropic credential from stalling until the no-output watchdog when Claude Code never reads the credential pipe. (#174571; fixes #174204) Thanks @RomneyDa and @scalesmart.
- Plugins: restore the SDK facade exports that published external plugins still import, so those plugins load again. (#173777; fixes #173386) Thanks @RomneyDa and @FtlC-ian.
- Chat tools: keep the chat usable after removing a tool server that failed to start, cleaning up its failed startup before reporting the launch error. (#171397) Thanks @joelagnel.
- Updates: bound the post-activation Doctor step by the update's allowance instead of waiting indefinitely with the Gateway down. (#173862)
- Updates: keep Gateway-managed source updates from failing with missing backup modules after the runtime is replaced. (#173587) Thanks @vishnusenthil-16.
- Updates: make `openclaw update --no-restart` honest for npm, pnpm, and bun installs, which restart themselves after the package is replaced, record the update as successful, and keep a still-serving older build unverified. (#173409, #174649; fixes #171311) Thanks @RomneyDa and @mwbroxson.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.10-beta.1..f90bd063751f2448330ee6abbb4c894508600d63 history: 24 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 24 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

name: v5.1.38
body:
5.1.37 was tagged but its publish stopped on Linux (the release binaries outgrew their size budget), so its main packages never reached npm; everything listed for it ships in this release. ([#10566](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10566))

**Release binaries may be up to 182 MiB.** The per-platform size budget moves from 160 MiB to 182 MiB after measuring what grew: the Bun 1.4.3 runtime adds 9.5 MB to every binary and the senpi update about 1.25 MB, so linux-x64 reached 173.4 MB. Nothing was bundled by mistake. ([#10566](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10566))

5.1.36 was prepared but never published; everything listed for it ships in this release. ([#10552](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10552))

**The engine moves to senpi 2026.10.19: a hung extension handler no longer freezes a session, and queued input survives a crash.** An extension handler that never settles on a lifecycle event is named in the session after 60 s and released after 20 min, or at once on Esc or the turn deadline. Input queued with a client id is written to the session file before it is queued and delivered exactly once. The mouse wheel scrolls the transcript again while a question prompt is waiting, Alt+Q restores queued messages on WSL, and the /btw panel no longer repeats a running eval's output in the scrollback. Anthropic requests of 4096+ characters to `api.anthropic.com` are now sent gzip-compressed, as Claude Code does. ([senpi#3650](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3650), [senpi#3549](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3549), [senpi#3604](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3604), [senpi#3628](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3628), [senpi#3649](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3649), [senpi#3643](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/3643), [#10552](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10552))

**Goals keep going while they make progress, and long sessions open and stay light (senpi 2026.10.18-1).** A goal no longer stops after a fixed 150 automatic continuations; it stops only after 60 in a row with no new tool effect, todo change or message from a person, and says why and that any message resumes it. Opening a very large session on a shared host no longer stalls the other sessions, a reopened session keeps only its latest compaction window in memory (four of the largest local transcripts went from 1441 MB to 216 MB of live heap), and reading a very long history over RPC pages instead of dropping the connection. A Claude subscription from `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` or an ambient Claude Code login now shows as a connected subscription, and a host daemon inherits every credential variable the engine reads. Provider accounts can be ordered, and grep starts 5 to 14 `rg` processes where it used to start 63 to 87. ([#10280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10280), [#10509](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10509)) The engine also fixes ChatGPT browser sign-in dead-ending on "State mismatch." when another session holds the callback port ([senpi #3627](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3627)), and a compiled engine now finds the Claude Code binary shipped beside its executable instead of failing the lookup ([senpi #3640](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/3640)).

**A client re-attaching to a retained session gets the full task snapshot again, and can pull it on demand.** The task RPC bridge listens for `session_resumed`, which senpi fires when the first client re-attaches to a still-open session, and re-emits the complete `omo.task.updated` snapshot instead of waiting for the next store change to alter its fingerprint; a new `omo.task.list` request answers the same payload for the parent session it names. ([#10016](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10016), [#10122](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10122))
**Memory recall's search index takes a quarter of the memory it did, and a memory write no longer rebuilds it.** Every session that recalls memory keeps a search index of the whole memory. It stored each note's words as a separate table, so a memory of 6,406 notes cost about 231 MB per session, and each memory write threw the index away and rebuilt it, taking 3 to 11 seconds. Words are now numbered once and each note keeps a compact list of numbers that survives a memory write, so the same memory costs 55 MB and a write updates the index in about 16 ms. The notes found and their order are unchanged. ([#10510](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10510), [#10512](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10512))

**A background task child follows its session when another client replaces it.** A raw RPC client that issues `new_session`, `switch_session` or `fork` on a daemon child's routing handle moves that session to a new durable id and transcript; the child now observes the `session_replaced` record, re-stamps its record's session path and durable id, appends a `replaced` task event, and reattaches to the new transcript instead of the abandoned one. When the replacement stops a turn the child was running, the child ends `interrupted` with the reason and a `task_send` action, and the parent is notified because it did not ask for that stop (a parent's own interrupt stays silent); this needs a senpi that names the cause on `agent_end` (senpi#3357), and an older host keeps the previous error. ([#10018](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10018), [#10112](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10112))
**`unspecified-low` tries GLM 5.3 before GPT.** A user with Claude and Z.ai (or OpenCode Go) but no Xiaomi or xAI provider used to fall from Sonnet 5.5 straight to GPT-6.1 Sol once Sonnet was unavailable. The chain now has `glm-5.3` at high thinking right after Grok 4.7 and ahead of the GPT rungs, so the order for users who hold MiMo or Grok is unchanged. ([#10306](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10306), [#10311](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10311))

**`omo --help` no longer moves your OpenCode config before you start a session.** On a fresh install `--help` (and `--list-models` / `--list-tips`) loads the omo extension, and its startup migration moved `~/.config/opencode/oh-my-openagent.json` into `~/.omo/migration-backup-*`, so a 4.19.x OpenCode plugin fell back to its defaults. The migration now runs only on launches that can start a session, and `--help` still lists omo's own flags. Thanks to @bluet for the report and @twotnguyen for #10433. ([#10428](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10428), [#10454](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10454))

**Built, tested and released on Bun 1.4.3.** CI, the release workflows and the devcontainer move from Bun 1.4.2 to 1.4.3, the current stable release, which fixes CVE-2026-48618 (TLS host names) and idle garbage collection in workers. ([#10432](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10432))

**OpenCode edition: Sisyphus names GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna as themselves.** On `gpt-6.1-sol` (and its `-fast`, dashed and Venice `gpt-61-sol` ids) and on `gpt-6-luna`, the Sisyphus and Sisyphus-Junior GPT prompts introduced the model as "a GPT-family model"; they now say "GPT-6.1 Sol" and "GPT-6 Luna". ([#10291](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10291), [#10292](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10292))

**Memory session shutdown waits for the work it started in the memory directory.** Shutdown now waits, within its existing drain budget, for an in-flight repo maintenance pass and for the status refreshes started at bind and settle, all of which run git inside the identity directory. Before, they could still hold files open after shutdown returned; on Windows the next delete of that directory failed with `EBUSY`/`EFAULT`, which is how the memory pressure-dream test failed intermittently in CI. ([#10154](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10154), [#10312](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10312))

**Oh My OpenAgent loads on OpenCode 2.** OpenCode 2 refused the plugin with `Plugin must export a default definition with an id and an effect or setup function`, because both entry points exported only the OpenCode 1.x shape. The server and TUI entries now also export an OpenCode 2 `setup` built with `Plugin.define` from `@opencode/plugin`, next to the OpenCode 1.x `server` and `tui` entries, which keep working as before. Each OpenCode 2 start shows a notice that points to OmO Native, with the install command and guide link. ([#8485](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8485), [#10439](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10439))

**The frontend skill keeps coloured edge stripes off rounded cards, and a linter catches the ones that slip through.** A card with a coloured stripe along one edge, its rounded corners bending the stripe, is one of the most recognizable marks of generated UI, and the skill only banned it when the stripe marked a selected or focused item. It now rules the stripe out before drafting, whether it decorates the card or marks state, and offers what to use instead: a tonal surface, a heading in the accent colour, a glyph, or spacing. The new `check-accent-stripes.ts` script finds the pattern in CSS, Tailwind classes, inline styles, and styled-components, and the skill's checklist runs it before visual QA. Focus rings, form validation, neutral dividers, and tables are left alone. ([#10437](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10437))

**A store extension's `orderBy` can only name columns its statement returns, and its text never reaches the SQL.** `orderBy` used to be pasted into the gateway's ordered read as given, so a `LIMIT`, an `OFFSET` or a column the statement does not select failed as broken SQL (`near "LIMIT": syntax error`, `no such column`). Each comma-separated term must now be one of the statement's own output columns (matched case-insensitively, as SQLite does), optionally with `COLLATE BINARY`/`NOCASE`/`RTRIM`, `ASC`/`DESC` and `NULLS FIRST`/`NULLS LAST`. The ORDER BY is rebuilt from the matched column name and those fixed keywords. Anything else, including quoted or bracketed names, comments, look-alike Unicode letters and unknown columns, is refused with `extension_schema_violation` and a message that names the rule and the columns the statement does return; put a `LIMIT` in the statement itself. ([#9626](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9626))

**The standalone `omo` binary's `omo setup` carries your OpenCode model choices again.** The release binary printed `could not read the engine's model list (ENOENT ... '/package.json')` and skipped the default model and agent/category picks, and it would have imported a user skill named like a bundled one over the bundled skill. Setup in the binary now reads the provider catalog and bundled skills it ships with; the npm install is unchanged. Thanks to @bluet for the report. ([#10429](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10429), [#10455](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10455))

**Only you can stop computer use with the stop chord on macOS and Linux X11.** A chord a program sends (the agent's own key presses, `xdotool`, another app posting key events) used to stop every session, and repeated, could keep computer use stopped; it is now ignored, while a press on a real keyboard still stops every running session at once. Wayland's shortcut portal cannot tell the two apart, and Windows follows in a separate change. ([#10444](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10444), [#10449](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10449))

**On Windows every session can now arm the stop chord, and only a key press on a real keyboard triggers it.** The chord used to be a `RegisterHotKey` registration, which only one process can hold: a second session's engine could not arm it, so its computer use refused input with `StopPathUnavailable`; and a chord a program sent (the agent's own key presses or any other app's `SendInput`) stopped computer use like a real press. A low-level keyboard hook now watches the chord in every session, ignores injected key events, and never swallows a key; one physical press stops every running session at once. ([#10444](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10444), [#10453](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10453))

**Computer use works on arm64 Linux and Windows.** Each OmO release now carries the desktop engine for Linux arm64 (glibc) and Windows arm64, built on native arm64 machines and checked with its self-test before upload. The compiled OmO binaries for those hosts include the engine, and an npm install downloads it on first use, where it used to report that no engine is built for the host. Musl Linux still has no engine. ([#10440](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10440), [#10442](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10442))

**A memory-sync account can be recovered on a new device with a passkey.** memory-core can enroll a dedicated recovery passkey and, on a fresh device, use it to rejoin the account: the device's native bridge derives the recovery keys from the passkey and keeps them in the main process, the device walks the served history from the recovery key's own record and pins it, and only a wrap that record vouches for is opened. A wrap the server made up is refused, whatever the server sends. Nothing syncs to a server yet. ([#10412](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10412))

**`herdr agent prompt` reaches OmO panes.** herdr only types into a pane whose foreground process it can name, and the OmO engine runs as `bun …/cli.js`, so every OmO pane was refused with `agent_not_ready`. Under herdr, the interactive engine now starts with `HERDR_AGENT=pi`, the label herdr already shows for these panes. OmO drops it from the environment it hands to anything it starts. Thanks to @devswha for the report. ([#10448](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10448), [#10452](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10452))

**A memory writer killed mid-commit no longer leaves the next writer stuck on a git lock, and a live commit's lock is never taken.** When a memory writer dies holding a git `index.lock` or ref lock, the writer that takes over its memory-write lock now removes that lock, but only after proving the previous owner dead, seeing no other process still working in the repository (a killed writer's own git command can outlive it), and seeing no process holding the file open. When any of that cannot be proven, including when the open-file check is slow or never answers, the lock stays put and the write fails with an error that names each lock file, says why it was kept, and gives the way out: `/memory unlock <path>` re-checks that one lock, shows what it found, refuses while any live holder, repository user or memory writer is visible, and removes only that file after you confirm (`--force` skips the prompt in a non-interactive session, never a refusal). On Linux desktops and SSH logins where some of your own processes cannot be inspected, the automatic removal does not fire and this command is the way out; [#10322](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10322) tracks making liveness independent of `/proc`. On Linux this check reads `/proc` directly, so recovery also works on minimal installs and containers without `lsof`. ([#10177](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10177)) ([#10199](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10199))

**Synced memory refuses a forged or reordered history on the device, the same way the server does.** memory-core now checks every sync object, the hash chain linking them, and the device keyring folded from it, using the format the service ships. A device rejects a record signed by a key that was rotated out or revoked, a dropped or reordered entry, a recovery join from a removed recovery key, and a batch sealed for another account. It treats the server as untrusted: a device trusts an account history only if it starts from the root it pinned during its own pairing or recovery, so a history the server invents, or a different root that looks valid, is refused before any key is opened. A key wrap opens only from a record of that trusted history, and only through the device's own keyring. A missing or damaged pin is treated as no trust at all, and the device asks to re-pair or recover. A replayed batch, a swapped record body, an unsigned row in a vetoed epoch and a row with fields the format does not define are each refused and counted. Nothing syncs to a server yet. ([#10178](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10178), [#10298](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10298))

**A memory that already exists on a device joins its synced space without losing anything.** Each project's synced memory gets one identity that every device computes the same way from the repository, so two devices enabling sync offline land in one space. When local files meet the space's copy, nothing is deleted: body lines are only added, a list keeps every element from both sides, and a frontmatter value that differs keeps both whole values side by side, never spliced together and never a conflict note in the file. Leftover hub conflict copies are folded in and removed only after a read-back proves every line made it. Nothing syncs to a server yet. ([#10206](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10206))

**`runtime_fallback` moves to the next model when a Cursor pool is spent.** cursor-opencode-provider reports a spent pool as `capacity_limit`, which the fallback classifier did not recognize, so the session ended on the error instead of trying the next rung of the chain. It is now treated like the `resource_exhausted` error it replaces. ([#10170](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10170), [#10224](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10224))

name: CC Switch v4.0.16
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.16

本版本把托盘改为快捷面板，并修复了一批 Codex 与路由问题。现在点托盘图标会弹出面板，能看到各应用正在用的供应商、模式、额度和用量，也能直接搜索、切换供应商；想用原来的菜单，可以在「设置 → 通用 → 托盘样式」里换回。Codex 聚合模式下，会话在默认供应商和其他成员之间切换后不会再卡在原来那家反复压缩失败；Codex 走路由时，每次重启 CC Switch 都要重新登录 ChatGPT 的问题也已修复。Codex 经路由连 Chat 上游时，并行工具结果不再被中途插入的提示拆开、报 400；自己填的 GPT 上下文窗口对官方同名模型也生效了，4.0.13 加的 272K 封顶改为只限制借用原厂数据的窗口。上游是 5.5 模型时，Claude Code 路由和 Claude Desktop 路由模式都改用 5.5 的模型 ID。另外修复了智谱按量付费账号显示「额度没查到」、新建的火山套餐卡片额度直接报错、Windows 上认不出 fnm 管理的 Node 工具、空闲的卡片删不掉、编辑供应商时「获取 API Key」链接不见等问题，macOS 图标底色也改成了柔和的浅灰。OpenCode 的卡片现在可以设为 OpenCode 的默认模型。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.16-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.16-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

**托盘改为快捷面板**（[#8432](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8432)）。在 macOS 和 Windows 上，点托盘图标现在会弹出快捷面板：「配置」页列出各应用正在用的供应商、当前模式（直连、路由、聚合用和主界面相同的颜色）和额度，可以搜索、切换供应商；「用量」页的趋势图跟随主界面选的币种和图表样式。macOS 上是系统毛玻璃，叠在深色窗口上也看得清；Windows 上是不透明卡片。想用原来的菜单，可以在「设置 → 通用 → 窗口与终端」的「托盘样式」里选「菜单」，立即生效，不用重启。Linux 仍是原生菜单，最上面多了一项「打开快捷面板」。

**OpenCode 卡片可以设为默认模型**（[#8509](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8509)）。OpenCode 启动时按 `opencode.json` 顶层的 `model` 选模型，以前 CC Switch 没法设置，只能手改文件。现在已添加的 OpenCode 卡片上有「设为默认」，选一个模型即可；只改顶层的 `model`，注释和 `small_model` 原样保留。

## 改进

**MiniMax 官方预设默认用 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash**（[#8518](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8518)）。Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Codex、Hermes、OpenCode、OpenClaw、Pi 都已更新，MiniMax-M3 仍可选择。

**「获取 API Key」链接恢复为浅蓝色**，不再带下划线。

**侧栏「今日」恢复「今日」前缀**，撤回 4.0.15 的改动。

**价格更新**：Kimi K3 补上缓存写入价（每百万 Token 3 美元，原来记成 0）；Step 5 Preview 的缓存读取价按阶跃星辰 10 月 14 日的调价改为每百万 Token 0.70 元；新增 qwen3.7-flash、qwen3.6-27b、qwen3.8-omni-flash 的价格。这两项改价会自动更新到已有的价格表，手动改过的除外。

**智谱的「获取 API Key」链接去掉了邀请码。**

**土耳其语**：改进了 17 处界面用语（[#8481](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8481)）。

**预设：** 新增 AllTokens SI。

## 修复

- **Codex 聚合模式下，会话换到另一家供应商后一直报错**（[#8485](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8485)）。会话在聚合的默认供应商和其他聚合成员之间换模型时，Codex 会先用原来那家压缩上下文；那家额度用完时压缩失败，之后每一轮都卡在同一处。现在聚合模式下第三方路由的模型和聚合成员用同一套压缩标识，不会再触发这次压缩，已经卡住的会话也能恢复。官方路由不受影响。
- **Codex 走路由时，每次重启 CC Switch 都要重新登录 ChatGPT**（[#8431](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8431)）。Codex 桌面版 26.1013 起，继续会话需要登录 ChatGPT。关闭「非接管切换时保留官方登录」、直连供应商是第三方时，退出 CC Switch 会收起登录并删掉 `auth.json`，下次启动也没有还回去。现在退出 CC Switch 时一律保留登录，真正退出路由时仍按这个设置处理；进入或接上第三方路由时，如果 `auth.json` 里没有登录，会还回最近收起的那份，之前已经这样丢掉的登录也能找回。
- **Codex 经路由连 Chat 上游时，并行工具结果被中途的提示拆开，报 400「No tool output found」**（[#7190](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7190)、[#7569](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7569)）。例如 Codex 看图片时插入的 `image_resize_notice`。现在这类提示不再打断工具结果，校验严格的 Chat 上游（如 DeepSeek）不再拒收。
- **自己填的 GPT 上下文窗口对官方同名模型不生效**（[#8366](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8366)、[#8350](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8350)）。现在按供应商或按模型填的窗口都会写进 Codex 的模型目录，自动压缩的阈值随之调整；没填时仍用官方默认值。Codex 经路由连 Gemini 时如果输入超长，现在会返回 Codex 认得的「上下文超长」错误，让 Codex 自己压缩。
- **4.0.13 的 GPT 272K 封顶把真有 1.05M 窗口的平台也封了。** 现在只有借用原厂数据的窗口才封顶到 272K：同一地址的预设、models.dev 按地址认出的供应商用它们自己的窗口，手填的窗口也照用；GPT 窗口超过 272K 时，Codex、Hermes、OpenClaw、OpenCode、Pi 的表单会在输入框下方提醒。OpenRouter、Vercel AI Gateway、Cloudflare AI Gateway、DigitalOcean 的预设恢复 1.05M。
- **路由下上游是 5.5 模型时，Claude Code 仍当成 5 的模型**（[#8450](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8450)）。现在 Opus、Sonnet 档的上游是 5.5 时，写给 Claude Code 的是 `claude-opus-5-5` / `claude-sonnet-5-5`，Claude Code 显示正确的模型，输出上限也从 64K 变为 128K；子代理模型同样处理。
- **Claude Desktop 路由模式下，目标是 5.5 模型时请求被上游拒收**（[#8082](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8082)）。以前发布给 Desktop 的模型名固定是 `claude-opus-5` / `claude-sonnet-5`，Desktop 按 5 的参数构造请求，5.5 上游不接受；手改生成的配置又会被下次写入覆盖。现在目标是 5.5 时发布 5.5 的模型 ID；映射表本身不变，旧配置发来的请求仍指向原来的目标。
- **Claude Code 经 Codex OAuth 使用带次数上限的 WebSearch 时直接报错**（[#7936](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7936)）。以前只有强制使用 WebSearch 时才放行，现在不强制也能用，次数上限通过提示约束，超出次数时这一轮响应会在返回时截断。
- **智谱按量付费账号的卡片显示「额度没查到」**（[#8465](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8465)）。智谱卡片默认查套餐额度，没有 Coding Plan 的账号会被当成出错。现在没有套餐时改为显示账户余额（团队套餐不回落）。
- **新建的火山 Agent / Coding Plan 卡片一上来就显示「额度没查到」**（[#8494](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8494)）。火山的套餐额度要用账号的 AccessKey ID 和 SecretAccessKey 查询，不是推理用的 API Key。现在用量设置里会预选火山，但填好 AccessKey 之前不启用查询；一键导入链接里明确写了启用的，照常启用。
- **Codex 官方卡的编辑器里，`auth.json` 显示的是旧登录。** 以前显示的是旧版本存下的登录快照，Codex 换过令牌后就和 `~/.codex/auth.json` 对不上；跟随当前登录的卡片则显示为空。现在未绑定托管账号的官方卡显示的是切换到这张卡后 `auth.json` 的内容；不动这个框直接保存，卡片原来的登录信息保持不变。切换时实际写入的文件一直是对的。
- **Windows 上用 fnm 管理 Node 时，认不出已安装的 Codex 等工具**（[#8484](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8484)）。fnm 只在各个终端里临时加 PATH，CC Switch 找不到 node 和 npm，应用内安装也报「'npm' 不是内部或外部命令」。现在会把 fnm 默认 Node 版本的目录加到 PATH 末尾，原有的 PATH 仍然优先。
- **空闲的供应商卡片删不掉，提示「无法删除当前正在使用的供应商」**（[#8506](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8506)）。常见于带着旧版 Claude Desktop 映射卡升级后，数据库里旧的「当前」标记还指着它。现在只看实际在用的直连供应商和路由目标，和界面上禁用删除的规则一致。
- **编辑供应商时「获取 API Key」链接不见了。** 现在编辑时会按当前地址找到对应的预设，显示它的链接，和添加时一样。
- **macOS / Linux 上误报环境变量冲突。** 以前会把 CC Switch 从启动它的程序继承来的环境变量也算进去（例如从 Claude Desktop 打开的终端里自带的 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`），这些在应用里也删不掉。现在只检查 shell 配置文件里的定义，Windows 不变。
- **MiniMax Code 的部分用量记录模型显示为 unknown。** 现在会从同一会话、同一时间的那条回复里找回模型名，能正常计价；已经导入的记录保持原样。
- **Hermes 里添加 MiniMax 官方供应商后请求发不出去**（[#8538](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8538)）。供应商标识按直觉填成 `minimax` 时，和 Hermes 内置的 MiniMax 重名，Hermes 会改用内置那家、要求设置 `MINIMAX_API_KEY`。现在 MiniMax 预设会预填 `cc-switch-minimax` / `cc-switch-minimax-en`；之前已经用 `minimax` 添加的，请改用别的标识重新添加。MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 也标为支持图片输入。
- **中文和日文下用量图的纵轴太宽。** 「5000万」「2000亿」这样的刻度改写成「5千万」「2千亿」，用量页和托盘面板的纵轴按最宽的刻度自动调整宽度，短刻度不再留空，长金额不再被截掉。
- **macOS 图标的白底太亮**（[#8495](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8495)）。4.0.15 的白色圆角方块改为浅灰，形状不变；Windows 和 Linux 图标不变。
- **「关于」卡片的 Logo 模糊**（[#8470](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/8470)）。改用矢量图。

## 升级说明

**数据库结构没有变化**，仍然是 20。

- 升级后点托盘图标会弹出快捷面板；想用原来的菜单，请到「设置 → 通用 → 托盘样式」里选「菜单」（macOS、Windows）。Windows 上左键点托盘图标以前是打开主界面，现在也弹出面板，主界面从面板底部的「打开主窗口」进入。
- 已保存的 GPT 模型窗口不做迁移。4.0.13 之前保存、自动填成 1.05M 的 Codex GPT 模型，这个值现在会生效；打开表单时会看到提醒，如果实际只有 272K，请手动改小。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @Owlbay（托盘快捷面板）、@funkpopo（托盘快捷面板、GPT 上下文窗口）、@parkavenue9639（Codex OAuth 的 WebSearch）、@waynesguan（Claude Code 的 5.5 模型 ID）、@A0150315（被拆开的工具结果）、@SaladDay（MiniMax-M3.1-Flash、Hermes 的 MiniMax 预设）、@alkank（土耳其语）的贡献。

感谢 @ht6231997Byte、@mybolide、@xiaohe622516、@Jokyuzx、@XiaoXiangGuRen、@BlueMain、@guaifinition、@fengzhcai、@Alicexs、@samuelhe52、@futurelyf、@actforjason、@yyhhkya、@107295472 报告问题、提供复现信息和修复思路。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

name: v2.8.10
body: > [!WARNING] > This release addresses security vulnerabilities (`GHSA-v77x-cvmx-ggp4`, `GHSA-qch9-77q9-j7p6`) affecting all versions up to and including **v2.8.9**. > **All users are strongly advised to upgrade to v2.8.10 immediately.** > > Full technical details will be published after the coordinated-disclosure window has passed. Thanks to **@marek-mraz**, and **@musicsms** for responsibly disclosing these. ## A little update from me Hey everyone! First off, I want to apologize for the slower releases lately. I haven't been doing too well health wise, so things slowed down quite a bit, and I haven't been able to review PRs or reply to issues as fast as possible I'm doing much better now, though, and I'm happy to say that **BentoPDF is going back to weekly releases!** I've been working on quite a few things behind the scenes, and the next update is going to be a big one. Here's what's coming: - **Measurement tools:** You'll be able to measure distances, perimeters, and areas directly on your PDFs. - **Favorite tools:** Pin the tools you use most so you don't have to keep looking for them. - **Air-gapped by default:** I'm gradually removing dependencies on third-party engines like Ghostscript and PyMuPDF and replacing them with our own engines, [[Kura](https://www.bentopdf.com/kura)](https://www.bentopdf.com/kura) and [[Hyper Compress](https://www.bentopdf.com/hyper-compress)](https://www.bentopdf.com/hyper-compress). - **A much faster Organize:** I've spent a lot of time optimizing the Organize tool, and the performance improvements are pretty significant. - **Digital signatures:** PAdES signatures with timestamps and long-term validation, along with certification signatures. - **Dark mode and color-blind modes** Most of my time, though, went into building a new lightweight, SOTA OCR engine for PDFs. It's fast, it performs at the level of vision language models (VLMs). Beyond reading text, it handles: - **Tables:** Recognizes tables, including merged cells, and reconstructs them into proper rows and columns that you can export to Excel or HTML. - **Formulas:** Recognizes mathematical expressions and converts them into LaTeX. - **Markdown export:** Converts entire pages into structured Markdown, preserving headings, lists, tables, and formulas. - **JSON export:** Provides recognized text along with its position on the page and confidence scores. - **Layout detection:** Identifies paragraphs, headings, lists, tables, captions, footnotes, forms, and more. - **Reading order:** Handles multi-column documents, magazines, and complicated layouts without mixing everything up. - **PDF tagging:** Can help turn unstructured PDFs into properly tagged documents. And yes, at one point I genuinely thought training an OCR model on my poor GTX 1650 was a good idea. Thank you for using BentoPDF and the support. More updates are coming soon ❤️ ## What's Changed * build(deps-dev): bump handlebars from 4.7.9 to 4.7.10 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/alam00000/bentopdf/pull/926 * build(deps): bump source-map-js from 1.2.1 to 1.2.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/alam00000/bentopdf/pull/927 * build(deps): bump PDF engine and viewer to 051abe5b72a9 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/alam00000/bentopdf/pull/932 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/alam00000/bentopdf/compare/v2.8.9...v2.8.10

name: v3.2.0
body:
## Archify v3.2.0

Create a conclusion-first one-page answer from Markdown, with cited sources, interactive diagrams and browser exports.

### Added

- **One-page answers (explainer) (#993).** Ask your agent to answer as a page and Archify builds a conclusion-first explainer from a Markdown draft. Each panel answers one question, using prose, tables, steps, checklists, charts, code and validated native diagrams.
  - **Authoring and delivery:** `finalize explainer` validates, delivers atomically and checks the page. Charts come from a Mermaid fence or a CSV/JSON file next to the draft. Repository excerpts are read from the pinned commit. `patch explainer` replaces one panel by ID.
  - **Reading:**
    - Steps sit beside the diagram they walk through, and you can step through them.
    - Text and diagram nodes highlight each other.
    - Clicking a node opens the full Viewer focused on it.
    - Citations and source-linked nodes open source cards.
    - Each panel or selected passage produces a follow-up question that targets that panel.
  - **Sharing:** the page ships in four styles (clean, editorial, product, Swiss) with light and dark themes, and exports a PNG, WebP or JPG long image or prints to PDF.
  - **Examples:** four live pages in `docs/cases/explainer/`.
  - **Credit:** the one-page document direction of #942 by @goatliamia shaped this work.
  - **Acknowledgment:** thanks to @QingYunA for the early one-page diagram-and-explanation proposal and demo prototype.

### Fixed

- **Explainer pages no longer carry local paths.** The draft embedded in a page names its source and data files relative to the page, so a shared page does not reveal the author's directories. `patch explainer` resolves them against the page again.

- **Explainer long images keep the page's style and theme.** A PNG, WebP or JPG export of a dark page, or of the editorial, product or Swiss style, came out in the light clean style, because the page is drawn inside an SVG where its `<html>` is not `:root`. The export now selects the page root by its own attribute.

- **Blank chart data is an error, not zero.** An empty CSV cell, a JSON `null` or a missing field in a charted column no longer becomes a zero bar. Finalize names the column and row instead.

- **Workflow migration semantic contracts (#497).** Layout planning no longer checks full-topology requirements against a temporary graph with routed edges removed. Migrated documents retain their authored contracts and must pass complete validation before publication.

- **Timeline 时区刻度（#926）。** 刻度按显示时区在各真实时刻的 UTC 偏移对齐，修复跨夏令时后日刻度漂移到 01:00／23:00、半小时跳变后小时刻度漂移的问题。回拨的重复时刻保持独立，跳过的小时或日期不生成虚构刻度；事件时间、标签精度、时间轴比例与断轴规则保持不变。

### Changed
- **Reader controls and node index.** Compact bottom index rows keep descriptions below titles; menu and roving keyboard navigation respect modifier keys.
- **Update notices.** Available updates include a release summary and an offer to help update. Network failures remain non-blocking.
- **Website and portability.** The bilingual homepage and gallery introduce one-page answers while retaining guides and source-backed cases. Browser discovery, Windows command paths, source-directory whitespace and temporary-worktree cleanup receive focused fixes.

### Distribution
- Download `archify.zip` below. Stable update notifications are published separately after the archive has been verified.
- The separately versioned DSH plugin is not republished with this release; maintainers must select a pinned source and complete its host/package acceptance in a separate follow-up.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/compare/v3.1.0...v3.2.0

name: v0.5.1
body:
# OpenViking v0.5.1

## 中文

本版本包含 v0.5.0 之后的 151 个提交，重点是 Gateway 部署与接入、隐私字段管理、批量写入、多模态检索，以及 Session 和后台任务的可靠性。**升级前请阅读下方兼容性与迁移：本次涉及 API 删除、写入语义和存储格式变化。**

### 主要更新

- **Gateway 可以直接运行在 OpenViking Server 内。** 开启 `gateway.enabled` 后，模型请求和管理接口统一位于 `/gateway`；独立部署仍受支持。Studio 新增快速配置、从 Server 导入模型设置和真实模型生成测试；上游支持精确 endpoint、自定义认证头及 URL 中的 key 占位符，覆盖 Azure 等接入方式。管理密钥与用户身份分开，配置了管理密钥后，修改上游和 context profile 必须提供它。请求准备、响应转发和历史响应查找也减少了 CPU 开销（#5960、#6100、#6101、#6107、#6118、#6026）。
- **隐私配置支持字段级引用和原子更新。** `ov privacy reference` 默认返回绑定 owner 的引用，`resolve` 才显式读取值；新增字段元数据、字段/目标删除、原子 PATCH，以及对已存内容的扫描和修复。扫描默认 dry-run，返回引用而不返回命中原值；多个字段登记了同一个值时报告歧义。修复单文件 no-split 导入的隐私处理（#6161、#6260）。
- **批量写入支持更多处理选项。** `batch_write` 新增整批 `processing_mode`，每个文件可带 tags 和 ACL；增加内容版本冲突检查及保留冲突文件的选项。变化文件统一维护语义与向量，`vectors_only` 不刷新父目录语义。正文已写入后，后台刷新入队失败会如实报错，正文不会回滚（#5897、#5750）。
- **检索支持文字与多图组合。** `find`、`search` 的 `image_url` 可传有序图片数组，Python SDK 支持对应输入；需要兼容的多模态 embedding。CLI 新增 `ov search --mode context`，可直接输出组装好的上下文。修复召回过的目录阻挡其下新文件的问题，缩短并限制 query planner 的处理，Hermes 排序移除字面词重叠加分（#6128、#5951、#5982、#6039、#6007、#5712）。
- **Session 和任务状态更准确。** 统一 task 与 queue work 跟踪，保留任务 owner；SessionCommit 第二阶段失败会进入终态错误，归档完成标记在任务结果保存后写入；注册任务前释放归档锁。减少消息写入、Session 接口和删除时的重复读取，移除文件任务存储的统一 I/O 限流；资源 `reason` 触发的记忆抽取入队后即可返回受理状态（#6043、#6122、#6136、#5772、#6153、#6175、#6270、#6165、#6265、#6077、#6157）。
- **多实例部署能力增加。** Session idle auto-commit 可选 Redis 分布式调度；Account Store 新增 MySQL 和 Redis+MySQL Provider，默认仍为 file。顶层 `service_name` 统一部署标识及共享缓存命名；多写存储升级为 V2 分区日志、checkpoint 和后台追平模型（#6046、#5933、#5955、#6011、#6014、#5741）。
- **Compile 和 Studio。** VikingBot Compile 使用可规划的 Map/Shuffle/Reduce 流程，增加临时路由 embedding 接口，并限制失败重试和停滞的 review 循环。Studio 改进 workspace 设置、连接恢复、模型配置及私有地址连接测试；ROOT 可保存启动配置并重启受支持的单 worker 服务，启动失败时尝试恢复之前实际运行的配置（#5750、#5989、#6133、#6066、#6148、#6177、#5730）。
- **Agent 集成。** 新增 Microsoft Agent Framework context provider；LangChain/LangGraph 修复 mapping、文本块、异步初始化和健康状态识别，框架包移到 `integrations/frameworks/`。共享插件新增 `ov-resources` skill、透传额外请求头和召回排除项；DSH 在压缩/启动时提交待处理消息；OpenCode 修复 session 归属和过期状态清理；Hermes Quick Local 支持 OpenViking 0.5（#5578、#6017、#5980、#6070、#5908、#5878、#6092、#5988、#5616、#5254、#6243、#5935、#5936、#6114）。
- **可靠性、安全与观测。** 统一模型错误分类和重试边界，识别 Ark 超时，保留输入错误、鉴权失败、超时和网络错误的区别；修复长 embedding 输入截断、PDFium 并发渲染、SVG 依赖、加密快照恢复、原生向量存储错误透传及租户过滤。新增 Connector 导入计数和按来源区分的 ingestion token 指标（#6047、#5950、#6102、#6045、#5771、#5952、#6049、#6052、#5803、#5945、#6245）。
- **MCP 下载原文件。** 新增 `download(uri)` 工具，返回一次性下载链接，默认约 10 分钟有效；Gateway 可代理文件链接。链接不需要 OpenViking API key，但部署在额外鉴权代理后时仍需该代理要求的请求头（#6119）。

- **提交与锁释放修复。** Session 在入队前创建 Task 并绑定 owner，修复 commit 返回 500；写入协调消息在生产方交锁及所属工作结束后释放锁，修复写入完成后移动、覆盖和删除仍返回 409。同时修复跨进程交接锁的本地状态清理，以及 HTTP 向量存储读取返回字段的问题（#6258、#6300、#6281、#6193）。
- **任务后端、解析与接入。** Task/Work 可选 MySQL 持久化后端（默认仍为 file）；parser 新增 `parsers.download_temp_dir`，允许底层文件系统支持的仅大小写不同文件名。Gateway 避免 DSH 和无工具辅助请求产生重复召回或新会话，LangChain 保留会话角色和工具历史；记忆更新重新读取失败时不再用旧快照覆盖（#6258、#6298、#6295、#6275、#6075）。Studio 完善界面本地化，Gateway 文档增加独立接入章节（#6292、#6287）。

### 用法示例

```bash
# 主包和 Python SDK
pip install --upgrade 'openviking==0.5.1' 'openviking-sdk==0.1.16'

# 独立 CLI
npm install -g @openviking/cli@0.5.1

# 组装上下文；完整结构使用 -o json
ov search '最近的设计决策' --mode context --events-time-decay-protection 7d

# 只获取隐私字段引用，不读取明文值
ov privacy reference credential github-prod api_key
```

```python
# Python SDK 0.1.16；服务端需配置支持多模态输入的 embedding
result = client.find(
    query="比较这两张图的共同主题",
    image=["./first.png", "./second.png"],
    limit=5,
)
```

### 兼容性与迁移

1. **Gateway 地址、管理权限和存储迁移（#5960、#6100）。** 先停止旧进程并备份完整 `storage_path`。客户端地址从 `http://host:1935/v1` 改为 `http://host:1933/gateway/v1`；Anthropic 使用 `http://host:1933/gateway`。独立网关默认仍监听 1935，但同样使用 `/gateway` 前缀。管理 API 从 `/api/v1/admin/gateway/*` 改为 `/gateway/admin/*`。嵌入部署移除 sidecar 和旧端口配置，`public_url` 使用 Server 对外地址且不带 `/gateway`。独立命令的连接参数迁入 `gateway.conf` 或环境变量。
   - 首次启动会用旧的 `OPENVIKING_GATEWAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY` 或 `storage_path/encryption.key` 解密旧数据，再按当前 OpenViking 加密配置写入。**若希望继续加密，必须在首次启动前启用 OpenViking 加密；否则转换后的数据是明文。** 缺少旧密钥时拒绝启动。
   - `OPENVIKING_GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN` 不会自动变为管理密钥。需要限制配置修改时显式设置 `gateway.management_key` 或 `OPENVIKING_GATEWAY_MANAGEMENT_KEY`；没有管理密钥时，同账号普通用户也可修改共享上游和 context profile。root/admin 身份不能绕过已设置的管理密钥。
   - 旧上游 Base URL 会做一次迁移以保持原请求地址；新建/修改按新规则处理。更换上游 `base_url` 会清除已存的 API key 和请求头值，需要同次提交新地址对应的凭据。详见[迁移指南](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/blob/v0.5.1/docs/zh/guides/22-gateway-operations.md#L306)。
2. **移除独立 Session extract（#6131）。** `POST /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/extract` 不再提供。改为 `POST /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/commit`，再按返回的 `task_id` 查询后台结果。commit 会按策略归档消息，与旧的直接抽取不同；受理不代表完成。
3. **移除等待专用 timeout（#6048）。** 资源、Skill、内容写入、删除和 system wait 的服务端/SDK/MCP 等待参数，以及 CLI 对应命令的 `--timeout` 已移除。保留 `wait`；请求时限由客户端 HTTP timeout 配置控制。升级 SDK 后删除方法调用中的 `timeout=`；不要把 HTTP 超时当成后台任务取消。
4. **`write(mode="create")` 不再保护已有文件（#5897）。** 它现在是 replace 的兼容别名，会覆盖已有正文；batch write 的 create/replace/upsert 同样写成请求的最终正文。依赖旧 `409 Conflict` 的调用方必须调整，不能继续用 create 作为防覆盖保障。batch write 可按实际需求使用 `expected_sha256` 和 `skip_conflicts`；它们不等同于旧的仅创建语义。正文提交后遇到派生处理失败，重试 replace 类写入时使用最终正文，勿直接重放已成功的 append。
5. **trusted 模式要求 root key（#5947、#5946）。** 所有部署（包括 localhost）必须配置非空 `server.root_api_key`；数据请求带匹配的 API key 和 account/user 身份头。trusted 模式新建身份不再生成个人 key，重置个人 key 返回 `FAILED_PRECONDITION`。已有 key 不会自动删除，也不参与 trusted 认证。
6. **共享缓存、Account Store 与多写存储（#6011、#6014、#5933、#5955、#5741）。** 将缓存命名配置迁到顶层 `service_name`，同一部署各实例保持一致，共享 Redis 的不同部署使用不同值。切换 Account Store Provider 不会自动迁移身份数据；MySQL 表需按仓库 SQL 事先建立，修改 `service_name` 会选择另一组逻辑分区。
   - V2 多写只直接读取 primary，primary 成功后异步持久化事件并同步 backup。旧 sync/ack/retry/operations/excludes/redirects 配置会警告后被忽略；旧持久化协议不自动转换。首次启用会导入 primary 现有文件，不删除 backup 额外旧文件。升级前完整备份，回滚时先恢复兼容备份，不能仅换回旧二进制。primary 写入与事件落盘之间崩溃可能遗漏复制事件，需从 primary 重建受影响 backup。
7. **Session idle 策略与检索校验（#6046、#5926）。** 新传入的 `idle_timeout_seconds` 必须为 0 或至少 300 秒；存量 1–299 秒值仍可读取。检索 `limit` 和显式 `node_limit` 必须为正数。
8. **插件采集替换范围扩大（#5937）。** `captureFilters` 的 `s` 替换规则现在也处理 tool input 的字符串值和 tool output；`d`/`k` 仍只用文本决定保留或丢弃。检查已有规则是否会改写需保留的工具内容。插件需在各宿主中单独更新，升级 Python 包不会自动更新插件。

9. **非空用户组可以直接删除（#6282）。** 删除组会移除其全部成员关系，但保留用户和凭证，不重写已有资源 ACL。依赖旧“先清空组才能删除”行为的管理界面应更新提示。
10. **可选 MySQL Task Store（#6258）。** 启用前安装 `openviking[mysql]` 并执行 `openviking/service/sql/task_store_init.sql`；配置 `storage.task_store.provider="mysql"`。不要让 FileStore 和 MySQL 同时作为同一部署的写入端。

### 已知限制

远端索引中，新导入资源的 glob 结果可能稍后才可见；写入后的即时检索应考虑重试。

感谢本次 12 位首次贡献者，名单见下方。

## English

This release contains 151 commits since v0.5.0, covering Gateway deployment, privacy fields, batch writes, multimodal retrieval, and Session/task reliability. **Read the migration notes before upgrading: this release changes APIs, write semantics and storage formats.**

### Highlights

- **Embedded Gateway.** Run Gateway inside OpenViking Server with `gateway.enabled`; model and management traffic use `/gateway`. Standalone deployment remains supported. Studio adds quick setup, model-setting import and generation-based upstream tests. Exact endpoints, custom authentication headers and API-key URL placeholders cover providers such as Azure. A separate management key controls upstream/profile edits. Request preparation, streaming relay and response lookup use less CPU (#5960, #6100, #6101, #6107, #6118, #6026).
- **Privacy fields.** Owner-bound references, explicit value resolution, field metadata, atomic PATCH, field/target deletion and stored-content scanning are available through the API and CLI. Scans default to dry-run and do not expose matched plaintext; duplicate registered values are reported as ambiguous. No-split file imports receive the privacy handling fix (#6161, #6260).
- **Batch writes.** Batch-wide `processing_mode`, per-file tags/ACLs, byte-revision conflict checks and conflict-preserving writes extend the content API. `vectors_only` maintains file vectors without regenerating parent summaries. If derived-work submission fails after content is written, the API reports the error and keeps the committed content (#5897, #5750).
- **Retrieval.** `find` and `search` accept ordered image arrays alongside text with a compatible multimodal embedder. Python SDK supports these inputs; `ov search --mode context` returns assembled context. Recalling a directory no longer hides new files below it. Planner prompts and work are bounded, and Hermes no longer boosts results for literal query-token overlap (#6128, #5951, #5982, #6039, #6007, #5712).
- **Sessions and background work.** Task and queue-work tracking converge, queue work retains its owner, SessionCommit phase-2 failures become terminal errors, and archive completion follows saved task results. Reduced repeated reads improve message writes, Session APIs and deletion. Resource-reason extraction returns once accepted into the queue (#6043, #6122, #6136, #5772, #6153, #6175, #6270, #6165, #6265, #6077, #6157).
- **Deployment options.** Redis-backed idle auto-commit, MySQL and Redis+MySQL Account Store providers, a shared top-level `service_name`, and V2 multi-write partition logs/checkpoints extend multi-instance deployments. File Account Store remains the default (#6046, #5933, #5955, #6011, #6014, #5741).
- **Compile and Studio.** VikingBot Compile gains a plannable Map/Shuffle/Reduce flow and transient routing embeddings, with bounded retries and stalled-review detection. Studio improves workspace setup, saved connections and model configuration. ROOT can save startup configuration and restart supported single-worker servers, with an attempt to recover the previously running configuration if startup fails (#5750, #5989, #6133, #6066, #6148, #6177, #5730).
- **Integrations.** A Microsoft Agent Framework context provider joins the framework integrations, now under `integrations/frameworks/`. LangChain/LangGraph, DSH, OpenCode and Hermes receive capture, initialization and session-state fixes. Shared plugins add the `ov-resources` skill and consistently forward extra headers and recall exclusions. Hermes Quick Local supports OpenViking 0.5 (#5578, #6017, #5980, #6070, #5908, #5878, #6092, #5988, #5616, #5254, #6243, #5935, #5936, #6114).
- **Reliability and observability.** Model error/retry classification preserves input, authentication, timeout and network distinctions. Fixes cover long embedding inputs, PDFium rendering, SVG dependencies, encrypted snapshot restore, native vector-store errors and tenant filtering. Connector-import counts and ingestion-token metrics identify source types (#6047, #5950, #6102, #6045, #5771, #5952, #6049, #6052, #5803, #5945, #6245).
- **MCP downloads.** `download(uri)` returns a single-use file URL, normally valid for ten minutes, with optional Gateway proxying. OpenViking needs no API key on that URL; an outer authenticated proxy may still require its own headers (#6119).

- **Commit and lock fixes.** Sessions create their Task and bind its owner before enqueueing, fixing commit HTTP 500 errors. Write coordination waits for producer handoff and owned work before releasing locks, fixing subsequent move, replace and delete operations returning 409 after a completed write. Cross-process handoff cleanup and HTTP vector-store response parsing are also corrected (#6258, #6300, #6281, #6193).
- **Task storage, parsing and integrations.** MySQL is an optional Task/Work backend; file remains the default. `parsers.download_temp_dir` controls parser temporary storage, and case-only filenames follow the underlying filesystem. Gateway avoids duplicate recall/new sessions for DSH and tool-less auxiliary requests; LangChain preserves roles and tool history. Memory updates no longer overwrite from a stale snapshot when the fresh read fails (#6258, #6298, #6295, #6275, #6075). Studio localization and dedicated Gateway documentation are expanded (#6292, #6287).

### Upgrade and migration

```bash
pip install --upgrade 'openviking==0.5.1' 'openviking-sdk==0.1.16'
npm install -g @openviking/cli@0.5.1
ov search 'recent design decisions' --mode context --events-time-decay-protection 7d
ov privacy reference credential github-prod api_key
```

1. **Gateway migration (#5960, #6100).** Stop the old process and back up its complete `storage_path`. Embedded client URLs change from `http://host:1935/v1` to `http://host:1933/gateway/v1`; Anthropic uses `http://host:1933/gateway`. Standalone still defaults to port 1935 but also requires `/gateway`. Management moves from `/api/v1/admin/gateway/*` to `/gateway/admin/*`. Remove the old sidecar/port configuration, set `public_url` to the server origin without `/gateway`, and move standalone command-line connection settings into `gateway.conf` or environment variables.
   - On first startup, the old `OPENVIKING_GATEWAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY` or `storage_path/encryption.key` decrypts existing data before it is rewritten under the current OpenViking encryption configuration. **Enable OpenViking encryption before this startup to keep data encrypted; otherwise the converted data is plaintext.** Missing legacy keys prevent startup.
   - The old admin token is not a management key. Set `gateway.management_key` or `OPENVIKING_GATEWAY_MANAGEMENT_KEY` to restrict configuration edits. Without one, ordinary users can edit shared upstreams/profiles in their account. Admin/root identity does not bypass a configured management key.
   - Stored upstream URLs receive a one-time migration to preserve request destinations. Changing `base_url` clears stored provider credentials and header values; send credentials for the new destination in the same update. See the [migration guide](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/blob/v0.5.1/docs/en/guides/22-gateway-operations.md#L306).
2. **Session extract removed (#6131).** Replace `POST /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/extract` with `commit`, then inspect its returned `task_id`. Commit archives messages under the retention policy; acceptance is not extraction completion.
3. **Wait-specific timeout removed (#6048).** Remove method-level `timeout=` and the corresponding CLI `--timeout` from resource, skill, content, deletion and system-wait operations. `wait` remains; configure the client's HTTP timeout instead. An HTTP timeout does not cancel background work.
4. **Create now overwrites (#5897).** `write(mode="create")` aliases replace and no longer returns the old existence conflict. Batch create/replace/upsert also write the requested final content. Callers relying on create-only protection must change; byte-revision checks and `skip_conflicts` are not equivalent to create-only semantics. Retry final-content replacement after derived-work failures; do not blindly replay an append that already succeeded.
5. **Trusted authentication requires a root key (#5947, #5946).** Every deployment, including localhost, needs a nonblank `server.root_api_key`. Data requests carry the matching API key and account/user headers. New trusted identities have no personal key; resetting a personal key returns `FAILED_PRECONDITION`. Existing keys are not deleted and do not authenticate trusted requests.
6. **Shared cache, Account Store and multi-write (#6011, #6014, #5933, #5955, #5741).** Move cache naming to top-level `service_name`; instances in one deployment share it, while distinct deployments on one Redis use different names. Account Store changes do not migrate identities automatically. Create MySQL tables from the repository SQL before use; changing `service_name` selects another logical partition.
   - V2 multi-write reads only the primary and persists events/replicates backups asynchronously after primary success. Legacy sync/ack/retry/operations/excludes/redirects settings warn and are ignored; old persisted protocols are not converted. First enable imports primary files without deleting extra backup files. Back up before upgrading and restore a compatible backup before rolling back the binary. A crash between primary write and event persistence can lose a replication event; rebuild an affected backup from the primary.
7. **Validation changes (#6046, #5926).** New positive `idle_timeout_seconds` values must be at least 300 seconds (0 disables it); existing smaller values remain readable. Retrieval `limit` and explicitly supplied `node_limit` must be positive.
8. **Capture filtering (#5937).** Substitution rules now rewrite strings in tool inputs and tool outputs. Drop/keep rules still examine text only. Review existing substitution rules and update plugins separately in each host; upgrading the Python package does not update installed plugins.

9. **Nonempty groups can be deleted (#6282).** Deletion removes all memberships while retaining users and credentials; it does not rewrite resource ACLs. Update management UIs that assumed a group must first be emptied.
10. **Optional MySQL Task Store (#6258).** Install `openviking[mysql]`, apply `openviking/service/sql/task_store_init.sql`, and set `storage.task_store.provider="mysql"` before enabling it. Do not use FileStore and MySQL as concurrent writers for one deployment.

### Known limitation

With a remote index, newly imported resources may become visible to glob after the import response. Allow for retries when querying immediately after writes.

name: v0.99.0
body:
**Account failover, hibernation, and faster reloads**

### Highlights

- Automatically retry turns on the next pool account when one hits a usage limit, including for Desktop and SDK clients
- Hibernate idle sessions to free memory, with measured RAM status and transparent wake on the next interaction
- Reload and resume large sessions much faster by showing the local transcript immediately and sending only new history

### Improvements

- Support OpenAI Ultrafast speed tiers for GPT-6.1 Sol, with Fast commands and hotkeys that apply promptly
- Show saved accounts, cached quotas, and available resets in the startup account router and usage cards
- Polish usage cards with responsive gauges and compact Mil and Bil token totals
- Offer additional OAuth accounts in the login picker and reauthenticate saved accounts from it
- Show cache misses inline with more accurate cache reuse diagnostics
- Show Jcode inference spending balance
- Compress OpenAI and Anthropic request bodies to reduce upload time
- Build the /model picker off the UI thread for large remote catalogs
- Reconnect only changed MCP servers instead of restarting all of them
- Simplify swarm mode by removing the task graph and defaulting swarm root effort to low

### Fixes

- Keep startup headers and account rows on a single line at narrow widths
- Show usage-limit rejections clearly instead of stale quota bars
- Fix forked sessions failing on replayed Anthropic web search blocks
- Count Gemini thinking and tool-use tokens correctly in usage
- Keep streamed OpenAI output when the completion payload arrives empty
- Preserve token usage when requests are cancelled or fail
- Fix Windows named-pipe connections hanging or failing on startup probes
- Fix Firefox cold starts blocked by stale zombie processes
- Collapse expanded pinned todos and restore overall progress display

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/1jehuang/jcode/compare/v0.98.1...v0.99.0
