name: v1.18.0
body:
## Install

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.18.0
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@latest
```

## What's Changed

### Feature
* feat(#5313): fail closed when artifact-frontmatter-equals matches more than one artifact by @davdittrich in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5392

### Fix
* fix(#4901): phase complete never lowers the body Completed Phases counter by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5425
* fix(#4928): doc-writer handles targets with no runnable local entry point by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5432
* fix(#4915): execute-phase hands the regression file list and wave-failure tally across blocks by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5428
* fix(#4929): ui-researcher inventory gate cross-checks its first answer and falls back to the lockfile by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5435
* fix(#4927): plan-phase catches truncated plans, unverified gate baselines and the reversibility conflict by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5436
* fix(#4867): TDD review credits a RED-only probe plan with the GREEN of the plan that depends on it by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5444
* fix(#4799): a sequential executor in a linked phase worktree can commit on its phase branch by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5445
* fix(#4945): begin-phase replaces a wrapped Current focus whole and starts a gap-closure re-entry at the first plan to run by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5446
* fix(#4956): the shared-ID gate reads ready-ids as JSON, so it can mark requirements complete by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5448
* fix(#5449): the synthesizer returns SUMMARY.md inline when the runtime refuses to write it by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5450
* fix(#4947): update-plan-progress reconciles the pending-plan tail, replaces a bare TBD, and reports a skipped Progress row by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5452
* fix(#4972): phase complete names a verify:post audit that is missing or unresolved by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5453
* fix(#4993): ship-note CI recovery no longer waits on the review state by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5459
* fix(#5085): an isolated quick executor writes its SUMMARY at a worktree-relative path and stops on a guard denial by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5462
* fix(#5017): every reader and writer of the defaults store resolves its root like the loader by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5463
* fix(#5049): --prompt-file reaches review lanes that take the prompt path in argv by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5468
* fix(#5050): docs-update --verify-only asks nothing; verifier results stay under project_root and never collide by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5472
* fix(#5106): TDD gate accepts go test RED evidence, refuses build failures, and shares one test-file definition by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5475
* fix(#5113): phase add touches only its inserted block and depends on a phase that exists by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5477
* fix(#5045): scan command-valued git -c config for secret reads by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5478
* fix(#5122): agent_skills self-load names its own type, supplies its launcher, and skips the persona fallback by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5481
* fix(#5123): installed @ includes resolve for Kimi, and for Copilot and Antigravity with --config-dir by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5484
* fix(#5473): extract the commit subject byte-wise so a 112KB message is not slow in a UTF-8 locale by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5485
* fix(#5143): workflow shell fences capture the typed text once instead of splicing it by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5493
* fix(#5121): bound the SKILL.md read in skill discovery by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5499
* fix(#5287): the audit-milestone closure chain addresses the inserted phase, not the insert-after phase by @0xdhx in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5440
* fix(#5051): honor workstreams in quick task state updates by @agammann in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5373
* fix(#4890): separate global phase from roadmap counts by @agammann in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5374
* fix(#5327): probe capability-lock's own start-time on the first lock acquire, not at module load by @behruznassre in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5434
* fix(#5316): dispatch ship:pre step hooks in ship preflight by @davdittrich in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5391
* fix(#5409): stop Brave fetch following redirects by @davdittrich in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5443
* fix(#4926): accept any readable text-file input and exit non-zero when it cannot be read by @Maestro157 in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5314
* fix(#4943): pause work conventional commit by @denniyahh in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5150

* fix(#4939): answer a caller error for a missing phase dir by @drakeo338 in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5030
* fix(#5276): sandbox USERPROFILE in tdd_mode init tests by @Yi-111-a in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5281
* fix(#5187): prefer upstream/next for emitted attribution by @bshiggins in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5508

- report directory types in file listings. ([#5175](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5175)) Thanks @GDemay.

pip install "cua-sandbox==0.9.1"

body:
## What's Changed

* chore(main): release agent 0.9.1 ([#5147](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5147)) (4a8de41) by @cua-release-bot[bot]

* docs: four sections and fewer, plainer pages (CUA-1863) ([#5470](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5470)) (4589873) by @f-trycua
* fix(agent): map Anthropic 5-series computer-use tool version, including Bedrock and Vertex ids ([#5138](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5138)) (79e5da2) by @injaneity
* ci(release): give Spaces, the SDK and the Python/npm packages the Cua Driver/Lume changelog and contributor credits ([#5127](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5127)) (e138b1d) by @ddupont808


**Dependencies:** cua-sandbox 0.9.1, cua-core 0.3.2

Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

## The short version

- **Native chat (experimental):** Use Antigravity in chat, choose which agents open as chats, and install a missing agent from the chat itself. Paste copied files as attachments, queue images, and see clearer feedback while attachments and queue actions are pending.
- **Accounts & agents:** After switching Claude accounts, restart running sessions on the new account. Remove downloaded agent runtimes from Settings, and edit or delete Linear comments through the Orca CLI.
- **Phone:** Edit queued messages in place, follow tool runs with desktop-style cards, and see your conversation immediately when resuming from history. Landscape phones put session tabs in the top bar, and Tasks makes clear which desktop you’re using.
- **SSH & remote workspaces:** Disconnect stays disconnected, sleeping workspaces stay asleep, and closed tabs stay closed after reconnecting. Clearer server update and re-pairing messages help you recover a connection.
- **Everyday polish:** Quick Command shortcuts follow the focused split, tab previews wait for the full hover delay, and file headers offer Reveal in Finder. Workspace cleanup better protects same-path projects on other machines.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

**Native chat (experimental):** Some chat features require support from the remote host. Keep the host updated alongside Orca to use the latest capabilities.

**The `orca` command on SSH hosts:** Existing hosts retain explicitly saved CLI control preferences; an unset preference is migrated to off. To allow commands on a connected SSH host to open and control this desktop’s Orca browser tabs for that host’s workspaces, enable **Allow this host’s orca CLI to control Orca** under Settings → SSH Hosts → edit the host → Advanced Connection.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Choose which agents open as chats, use Antigravity, attach files and images more reliably, and see clearer queue, model and input-ownership feedback.*

* Offer Install when a chat’s host is missing the agent it needs by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29051
* Chat: dropped files hold Send until they're attached by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29173
* A queue action still on its way greys its controls, like the phone by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29120
* Image messages wait in the queue like text by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28655
* Chat: pasting a copied file attaches it, like dropping it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29089
* Choose which agents open in native chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29071
* A sign-in prompt on an ACP agent's error output ends the start or turn signed out by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28467
* An agent can run each chat's own permission mode itself by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28455
* Hide Orca's chat-naming requests from Session History by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30029
* A running Claude chat keeps its model when two Claude Code versions list differently by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30022
